You'll have the room to grow, the flexibility to balance life with work, and the opportunity to better health worldwide, together.

Founded in 1992, Anda Inc. is an independent, wholly owned subsidiary of Teva Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd. As the 4th largest pharmaceutical wholesaler, we play an important role in the healthcare supply chain by providing distribution services across a broad portfolio of products throughout the United States, Puerto Rico, and the U.S. Virgin Islands.

At Anda, you will be part of a collaborative, high‑performing team focused on supporting our customers and the patients they serve. We value fresh thinking, shared accountability, and a commitment to doing what’s right for our customers and communities. Here, you will have the opportunity to grow your career, contribute to meaningful work, and be part of an inclusive culture where collaboration and purpose come together in support of better health.

Our Team, Your Impact

The position is responsible for all sales activities and management of assigned accounts associated to the AndaMeds division. Key objective of this role is to drive revenue/GP and to achieve the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) revenue. This is done through executing sales strategies within the assigned accounts, maximizing all opportunities, seeking out and capturing new prospective customers while growing existing relationships. This will be done while continuing to provide exceptional customer service. The role will require the individual to utilize analytical thinking skills, employ consultative and transactional selling techniques, and working cross-functionally with internal departments for effective operations and performance management.

How You’ll Spend Your Day

ESSENTIAL AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

All areas of responsibility listed below are essential to the satisfactory performance of this position by any incumbents with reasonable accommodation if necessary. Any non-essential functions are assumed to be included in other related duties or assignments.

• Responsible for executing the AndaMEDs sales strategy with assigned accounts to ensure quarterly/annual revenue and GP goals are attained.
• Establishes, maintains and grows both new and existing relationships with regional/national customers and key stakeholders to deliver long-term successful partnerships.

• Becomes the subject matter expert on assigned accounts by understanding the customers’ needs, strategies, and objectives and utilizes this expertise to develop unique, customized programs as some customers are high profile accounts spanning broad geographic areas, representing significant revenue and having diverse complex needs.
• Provides analytical support and analysis for account base to review sales performance and opportunities for customer growth and expansion. Has a solid understanding of the institutional business, the product /services and the market and the challenges and opportunities therein.
• Identifies and understands the market landscape, the competition, and is forward thinking in creating new programs and opportunities to stay ahead of the industry changes.
• Coordinates efforts internally by working cross-functionally with all departments to facilitate and to ensure we build strong working relationships for maximum account performance.
• Collaborates with customer support functions and provides regular updates on account opportunities and strategies so they can execute against the business plan
• Engages with various teams on addressing customers’ sales and operational needs
• Facilitates weekly, monthly, quarterly calls and business reviews with customers
• Communicates with Director/TL KAMs and management team on the strategies and tactics being employed within assigned accounts by providing routine updates and reporting.
• Carries out responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies, procedures, and state, federal and local laws.
• Travel to attend all relevant industry events, trade shows, customer meetings and conferences.

Your Skills and Experience

Any equivalent combination of education, training and/or experience that fulfills the requirements of the position will be considered.

Education/Certification/Experience:

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in the pharmaceutical and or secondary wholesale industry required.
• Bachelor’s degree preferred; a combination of education and/or industry experience will be considered.
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in sales, account management, and/or general management
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in and knowledge of various distributions and selling channels

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

• A commercially minded account manager with institutional and medical group practice selling experience. Understanding of pharmaceutical distribution in both the primary and secondary markets.
• Solid negotiation, collaboration and influencing skills, both internal and externally. Develops colleagues’ and customers’ understanding.
• Solid strategic skillset with demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategies based on competitive dynamics, economic goals and customer requirements/needs.
• Analytical with demonstrated ability to succeed in data-driven, process-oriented environment.
• Strong oral and written communication skills. Ability to deliver effective presentations to C – suite level executive audiences with support from Dir, Account Management.
• Ability to adapt in a rapidly changing industry environment and possess the ability to manage the complexity inherent in the pharmaceutical business.
• Problem solving and issue resolution capabilities.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

Approximately 25% domestic travel throughout the US.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

Occasional:

• Sitting for extended periods of time at work station or mobile equipment.

Visual Acuity:

• Perform activities such as computer work, preparing and analyzing data, and extensive reading.

Salary Range

The annual starting salary for this position is between $120,000 – $153,000 annually. Factors which may affect starting salary within this range and level of role may include geography/market, skills, education, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.

How We’ll Take Care of You

At Teva, better health starts from within, and that includes you. From day one, you’ll be supported with benefits designed to help you thrive in and out of work. This includes generous annual leave, reward plans, flexible working schedules (dependent on role), access to tailored health support, and meaningful ways to give back to the community.  When it comes to your career, you’ll be encouraged to explore, evolve, and shape your path. Twist, our one-stop shop for career development platform, gives you access to a wide range of possibilities, from learning programs and short-term projects to opportunities for internal growth. Here, you’ll be part of a culture that empowers you to reach your goals and prioritize your wellbeing every step of the way.

We offer a competitive benefits package, including:

  • Comprehensive Health Insurance: Medical, Dental, Vision, and Prescription coverage starting on the first day of employment, providing the employee enrolls.
  • Retirement Savings: 401(k) with employer match, up to 6% and an annual 3.75% Defined Contribution to the 401k plan.
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off including vacation, sick/safe time, caretaker time and holidays.
  • Life and Disability Protection: Company paid Life and Disability insurance.
  • Additional benefits include, but are not limited to, Employee Assistance Program, Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Tuition Assistance, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Account, Life Style Spending Account, Volunteer Time Off, Paid Parental Leave, if eligible , Family Building Benefits, Virtual Physical Therapy, Accident, Critical Illness and Hospital Indemnity Insurances, Identity Theft Protection, Legal Plan, Voluntary Life Insurance and Long Term Disability and more.

Service Infrastructure Engineer – Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: Service Infrastructure Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (United States)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are looking for a Service Mesh Engineer to design, deploy, and operate service mesh platforms — primarily Istio and Linkerd — that provide secure, observable, and reliable service-to-service communication across our Kubernetes estate. The role focuses on platform engineering, mesh adoption, mTLS, traffic policy, and helping application teams reap the benefits of a mesh without paying for unnecessary complexity. The ideal candidate has operated service mesh in production, deeply understands Envoy and the data plane, and brings both platform engineering discipline and pragmatic adoption strategies.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in platform engineering, SRE, or networking roles.
  • Hands-on experience operating Istio or Linkerd in production.
  • Strong understanding of Envoy proxy internals and configuration.
  • Deep Kubernetes expertise including networking, CNI, and ingress.
  • Strong understanding of mTLS, PKI, and certificate lifecycle management.
  • Experience with distributed tracing and observability for mesh traffic.
  • Proficiency in Go or Python for tooling and automation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across networking, application, and control plane layers.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cluster Istio or Linkerd deployments.
  • Familiarity with Cilium service mesh and eBPF networking.
  • Open-source contributions to service mesh projects.
  • Experience with SPIFFE/SPIRE for workload identity.
  • Exposure to zero-trust networking initiatives at enterprise scale.
How to Apply
Would you like to know more about this opportunity? For immediate consideration, please send your resume to  or contact us at (908) 505-3545. Learn more about Bright Vision Technologies at www.bvteck.com.

Bright Vision Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

raw.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Healthcare Staffing

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re looking for a bilingual Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive new business for a healthcare staffing services provider. In this role, you’ll connect with dental and medical clinic owners, office managers, and hiring decision-makers across the United States to introduce staffing solutions and build long-term employer relationships.

You’ll manage outbound prospecting, present trained graduates for administrative and patient-facing roles, negotiate placement fees, and coordinate job orders with the internal team. This position is ideal for a confident, organized sales professional who understands healthcare office operations and can turn cold outreach into lasting business opportunities.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Make high-volume cold calls to dental and medical clinics across the United States.
  • Introduce staffing services, identify hiring needs, and qualify prospective employer accounts.
  • Follow up consistently with prospects to generate new business opportunities.

Candidate Pitching & Solution Selling

  • Present trained graduates for front desk, patient coordinator, treatment coordinator, and administrative positions.
  • Match candidate profiles to employer requirements and communicate their value clearly in English and Spanish.
  • Address objections and guide prospective clients toward a hiring agreement.

Job Order Management

  • Gather detailed job orders and clarify role requirements, timelines, and compensation expectations.
  • Coordinate with the internal team to ensure suitable candidates are presented promptly.
  • Manage multiple open job orders while maintaining consistent prospecting activity.

Negotiation & Account Development

  • Negotiate placement fees and service agreements with employers.
  • Build and maintain relationships with clinic owners, office managers, and hiring decision-makers.
  • Follow up after placements, monitor client satisfaction, and identify repeat business and referral opportunities.

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Record outreach activity, client conversations, open job orders, and deal progress in the CRM.
  • Maintain an organized pipeline and ensure timely follow-ups.
  • Track sales activity and communicate pipeline progress, challenges, and opportunities proactively.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in outbound sales, business development, or B2B sales, ideally in staffing, recruiting, healthcare staffing, or professional services.
  • Professional fluency in both English and Spanish, written and spoken.
  • Comfort with high-volume cold calling, objection handling, and phone-based selling.
  • Strongly preferred: hands-on experience in a dental or medical office as a Front Desk Representative, Patient Coordinator, or Treatment Coordinator.
  • Understanding of healthcare office workflows, including patient scheduling, insurance verification, patient intake, and treatment coordination.
  • Strong relationship-building, negotiation, and closing skills.
  • Experience managing job orders, client requirements, or multiple sales opportunities simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms for lead tracking, outreach documentation, and pipeline management.
  • Excellent organization, time management, follow-through, and independent working skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience selling staffing or recruiting services to healthcare practices.
  • Familiarity with dental and medical practice staffing challenges.
  • Experience negotiating placement fees, service agreements, or B2B contracts.
  • Established knowledge of front desk and patient-facing administrative roles in healthcare settings.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You understand dental or medical office operations and can speak confidently with practice owners about their staffing needs.
  • You’re comfortable making cold calls, handling rejection, and consistently building your pipeline.
  • You take ownership of your sales targets, follow-ups, and client commitments.
  • You can switch naturally between relationship-building and direct sales conversations.
  • You communicate proactively and keep clients and internal teams informed.
  • You’re motivated by closing new business and developing long-term commercial relationships.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent outbound prospecting and a growing pipeline of qualified clinic prospects.
  • New employer accounts secured through effective outreach and negotiation.
  • Complete, accurate job orders that support timely candidate submissions.
  • Strong client relationships, repeat business, and referral opportunities.
  • Organized CRM records and reliable follow-up across all active opportunities.

Typical Day

Your day begins by reviewing your call list and prioritizing new prospects and follow-ups during U.S. Central business hours. You’ll spend much of your time calling dental and medical clinics, introducing staffing services, pitching trained graduates, handling objections, and moving interested employers toward agreements.

When a clinic is ready to hire, you’ll gather the job requirements and coordinate with the internal team to support candidate submissions. You’ll also follow up with existing accounts, explore additional hiring needs, and keep your CRM updated.

The role is primarily focused on outbound calling, business development, relationship management, and closing new

employer accounts.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. AI Rating & Recruiter Screening
  3. Technical/Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding

raw.description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect talented professionals with exciting career opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our client network includes growing startups, digital agencies, SaaS businesses, and technology-driven companies across sectors such as MarTech, FinTech, EdTech, and eCommerce. Rather than following the traditional outsourcing model, we place you directly within innovative companies, where you become a valued member of their team.

Job Summary

We are seeking an energetic and resilient Business Development Representative to join a dynamic, fast-paced sales team. In this role, you will play a key role in driving business growth, serving as the first point of contact for prospective B2B clients. Your focus will be on breaking into new accounts, generating interest in a leading solution, and developing a strong sales pipeline that contributes to the company's success. This role is ideal for a proactive hunter who thrives in a high-activity environment and is eager to sharpen their skills across the sales process.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive high-volume outbound prospecting activities through cold calling, email campaigns, and social media outreach.
  • Source, identify, and qualify high-potential leads within the target B2B market.
  • Handle objections confidently and navigate complex company structures to engage key decision-makers.
  • Conduct discovery calls to understand prospect challenges and connect their needs to the company's value proposition.
  • Keep CRM records and sales activity data accurate and up to date, ensuring smooth handovers to Account Executives.
  • Partner with marketing and sales leadership to strengthen outreach strategies, refine messaging, and improve prospect engagement.

Requirements

  • At least 2 years of experience in B2B sales or business development, preferably within a B2B SaaS environment.
  • A strong hunter mentality, with a proven ability to consistently manage high volumes of outbound calls.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with strong persuasion and influencing abilities.
  • A resilient mindset, with the ability to handle rejection professionally and remain persistent.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage a high-volume sales pipeline effectively.
  • Experience closing deals or overseeing the full sales cycle, from initial outreach to conversion.
  • Proficiency in modern sales engagement platforms, prospecting tools, and CRM systems.

Benefits

💰 Attractive base salary with high earning potential through uncapped commission

🚀 Clear opportunities for career advancement into senior sales positions

🎯 Performance-driven rewards, bonuses, and additional incentives

🤝 A supportive, collaborative team environment focused on achieving high performance

Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $20-$50 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical quality systems, GMP compliance, and quality oversight could help artificial intelligence better understand quality management practices and regulatory expectations?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical quality professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance professionals who can apply their expertise in quality systems, compliance, investigations, and GMP operations to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional position. You won't be preparing submissions, managing product registrations, or interacting with health authorities. Instead, you'll evaluate complex regulatory content, identify technical inaccuracies, assess regulatory reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated pharmaceutical and biotechnology content.

You'll analyze scientific, regulatory, manufacturing, and compliance-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in industry standards, regulatory frameworks, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, missing context, and flawed reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference relevant FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way

Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your regulatory affairs career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy

Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely

Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location, with flexibility based on project availability.

Explore the Future of Pharmaceutical Technology

Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while leveraging your existing regulatory expertise.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for professionals who can identify regulatory risks, evaluate compliance considerations, and communicate expert assessments clearly.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and assignment requirements.

Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance Subject Matter Expert (SME),: $25-$50 USD/hour

Compensation may vary based on experience level, area of expertise, and task complexity.

Project Details

    • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
    • Work Arrangement: Remote
    • Primary Location: United States preferred
    • Additional Markets: Professionals outside the United States may be considered if they possess substantial U.S. pharmaceutical industry experience
    • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
    • Project Type: Pharmaceutical AI content evaluation
    • Project Duration: Based on project requirements and assignment availability
    • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises prior to project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Pharmaceutical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced pharmaceutical regulatory professional who enjoys analyzing complex compliance requirements, evaluating technical information, and applying regulatory judgment, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of pharmaceutical AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced Regulatory Affairs professionals in the Pharmaceutical world who bring practical industry expertise and are comfortable reviewing technical information, exercising independent judgment, and clearly explaining their conclusions.

Required Qualifications

    • Minimum 4 years of pharmaceutical QA experience
    • Bachelor's degree or higher in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related discipline
    • Experience with GMP-regulated environments
    • Understanding of QMS, CAPA, deviations, and change control systems
    • Strong analytical and technical review skills
    • Ability to critically evaluate technical and regulatory information
    • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving skills
    • Excellent written English communication skills
    • Ability to work independently and follow detailed review instructions
    • Comfortable working within a task-based freelance engagement model

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • Quality Systems leadership experience
  • Inspection readiness experience
  • Supplier quality management experience
  • ASQ certification or equivalent quality credentials
  • Experience managing post-approval changes and variations
  • Technical writing or document review experience
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation, data annotation, or quality review activities

Experience with AI model evaluation, large language models (LLMs), research, or structured quality assessments is beneficial but not required.

Job Summary
We are seeking an Infrastructure Automation Engineer with deep Terraform expertise to design, build, and maintain the infrastructure-as-code foundations that power our cloud and hybrid environments. This role focuses on creating reusable Terraform modules, hardening pipelines, enforcing policy-as-code, and standardizing infrastructure delivery across multiple teams and cloud providers. The ideal candidate brings strong software engineering discipline to infrastructure work, has shipped production-grade Terraform at scale, and understands the operational realities of managing thousands of resources across many environments and accounts.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, and maintain modular, composable Terraform code that codifies the entire infrastructure estate across cloud accounts and environments.
  • Build a library of well-tested, reusable Terraform modules with clear interfaces, semantic versioning, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Implement Terraform automation pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Atlantis, Terraform Cloud, or Spacelift, with plan/apply gating, drift detection, and policy enforcement.
  • Define and enforce policy-as-code using Sentinel, Open Policy Agent (OPA), Conftest, or Checkov to prevent insecure or non-compliant infrastructure changes.
  • Manage Terraform state at scale with appropriate backend strategies, state locking, workspace organization, and disaster recovery patterns.
  • Drive multi-account, multi-region, and multi-cloud infrastructure provisioning strategies with clear isolation, naming, and tagging standards.
  • Implement infrastructure testing including unit tests with terraform-compliance, integration tests with Terratest, and policy tests across pull requests.
  • Collaborate with security, networking, and platform teams to embed guardrails directly into reusable modules and pipelines.
  • Standardize patterns for secrets management, identity federation, and least-privilege IAM through reusable Terraform abstractions.
  • Lead migrations from legacy, ClickOps, or non-IaC infrastructure into managed Terraform footprints with minimal disruption.
  • Drive cost optimization, tagging hygiene, and lifecycle management across the Terraform-managed estate.
  • Mentor engineering teams on Terraform best practices, anti-patterns, and pull-request review standards.
  • Maintain comprehensive runbooks, architecture diagrams, and onboarding materials for the infrastructure platform.
  • Stay current with Terraform, OpenTofu, and broader IaC ecosystem developments and recommend adoption where beneficial.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Five or more years of experience in cloud infrastructure or DevOps engineering, with significant Terraform focus.
  • Deep, hands-on expertise authoring and maintaining production Terraform across at least one major cloud provider.
  • Strong experience designing reusable Terraform modules with clean APIs and version discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Terraform state management, backends, and large-scale workspace organization.
  • Strong scripting skills in Python, Go, or Bash.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure code and automated policy enforcement.
  • Solid understanding of cloud networking, identity, and security primitives.
  • Strong Git-based workflows including code review, branching, and release management.
  • Excellent troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with multi-cloud Terraform (AWS + Azure or AWS + GCP).
  • Familiarity with Terragrunt, Atlantis, Spacelift, or env0.
  • Experience with policy-as-code engines (Sentinel, OPA, Checkov).
  • Contributions to public Terraform modules or providers.
  • Exposure to FinOps practices and tagging-driven cost governance.

raw.description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Adjuster General Sr

PRIMARY PURPOSE: To investigate and adjust property and casualty claims, both residential and commercial, with little to no supervision.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Inspects claims and contacts involved parties in a timely manner.
  • Investigates circumstances of claim(s) as required for coverage determination, cause, and compensable damages/reserves.
  • Examines insurance policies and other records to determine insurance coverage.
  • Prepares estimates for cost of repair and/or replacement.
  • Conducts interviews with claimant and witnesses regarding submitted claim(s).
  • Negotiates and settles both 1st and 3rd party claims.
  • Addresses salvage and subrogation as required by the client.
  • Maintains client relationships to assure repeated business referrals.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Supports the organization's quality program(s).
  • Travels as required.

QUALIFICATIONS


Education & Licensing
Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred. IIA-AIC designation required. Appropriate adjuster license is required.


Experience
Two (2) years of related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required.


Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong oral and written communication, including presentation skills
  • PC literate, including Microsoft Office products
  • Demonstrated commitment to timely reporting
  • Strong customer service skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Attention to detail and accuracy
  • Good time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment
  • Ability to meet or exceed Performance Competencies

The statements contained in this document are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by a colleague assigned to this description. They are not intended to constitute a comprehensive list of functions, duties, or local variances. Management retains the discretion to add or to change the duties of the position at any time.

raw.excerpt: Overview At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward.
raw.description:
Overview

At SCA Health, we believe health care is about people – the patients we serve, the physicians we support and the teammates who push us forward. Behind every successful facility, procedure or innovation is a team of 15,000+ professionals working together, learning from each other and living out the mission, vision and values that define our organization.

As part of Optum, SCA Health is redefining specialty care by developing more accessible, patient-centered practice solutions for a network of more than 370 ambulatory surgical centers, over 400 specialty physician practice clinics and numerous labs and surgical hospitals. Our work spans a broad spectrum of services, all designed to support physicians, health systems and employers in delivering efficient, value-based care to patients without compromising quality or autonomy.

What sets SCA Health apart isn’t just what we do, it’s how we do it. Each decision we make is rooted in seven core values:

  • Clinical quality
  • Integrity
  • Service excellence
  • Teamwork
  • Accountability
  • Continuous improvement
  • Inclusion

Our values aren’t empty words – they inform our attitudes, actions and culture. At SCA Health, your work directly impacts patients, physicians and communities. Here, you’ll find opportunities to build your career alongside a team that values your expertise, invests in your success, and shares a common mission to care for patients, serve physicians and improve health care in America.

At SCA Health, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to support your health, well-being, and financial future. Our offerings include medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k plan with company match, paid time off, life and disability insurance, and more. Please visit, to learn more about our benefits.

Your ideas should inspire change. If you join our team, they will.


Responsibilities

Position Purpose: The Senior Analyst, Revenue Cycle Systems & Optimization, reports to the Senior Director and supports the analysis, administration, optimization, and ongoing improvement of revenue cycle technologies and business solutions across the Central Business Offices (CBOs) and Revenue Cycle Operations (RCO). This role evaluates system performance, workflows, data, and AI-enabled capabilities to identify opportunities that improve cash acceleration, denial reduction, accounts receivable prioritization, productivity, quality, and decision support. The Senior Analyst partners with operational, technology, analytics, and vendor stakeholders to translate business needs into practical solutions and measurable results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the administration, analysis, and optimization of revenue cycle technologies, workflows, and system integrations serving the Central Business Office (CBO) and enterprise revenue cycle operations
  • Serve as a senior subject matter resource for revenue cycle platforms, system functionality, workflows, reporting, and user adoption
  • Partner with Revenue Cycle Operations, IT, Data & Analytics, Application Development, and external vendors to document requirements, evaluate solutions, and support technology roadmaps
  • Coordinate system implementation and expansion activities, including requirements gathering, testing, documentation, training support, new-facility onboarding, and transition readiness
  • Maintain system controls, governance documentation, audit processes, and standard operating procedures that support data integrity, compliance, security, and operational consistency
  • Analyze, prioritize, and track system enhancements, automation opportunities, defects, and process improvement initiatives
  • Investigate system incidents, coordinate issue escalation, and work with cross-functional partners to support timely resolution and minimize operational disruption
  • Develop, validate, and maintain key performance indicators, dashboards, recurring reports, and analyses that provide visibility into system effectiveness and revenue cycle outcomes
  • Support vendor management through issue tracking, performance analysis, release review, testing coordination, and evaluation of emerging capabilities
  • Assess automation, artificial intelligence, and advanced analytics solutions and support responsible adoption within revenue cycle workflows

Revenue Cycle Systems Support & Optimization

Artiva HCx

  • Support administration and optimization of the Artiva HCx platform across CBO-supported facilities in alignment with revenue cycle objectives
  • Coordinate onboarding and deployment activities for newly acquired or implemented facilities, including configuration review, testing, documentation, and readiness tracking
  • Monitor system utilization, workflow adherence, account inventory, and data quality; identify issues and recommend corrective actions
  • Develop, validate, and maintain operational reporting solutions, including delivered WebReports, custom reports, dashboards, Tableau analytics, and revenue cycle performance metrics
  • Work with vendor and internal partners to evaluate enhancements, test releases, document requirements, and resolve platform issues
  • Maintain payer configurations, data feed monitoring, user access processes, account reconciliation controls, and system administration documentation

Automated Refund Tool (ART)

  • Support the administration and monitoring of the enterprise refund management platform to promote compliance, efficiency, and standardized processes
  • Coordinate implementation, testing, documentation, adoption, and continuous improvement activities for refund automation
  • Analyze exceptions and workflow performance and collaborate with technology and operational partners on enhancement opportunities

INSPIRE Revenue Cycle Applications

  • Serve as a senior functional resource for revenue cycle-related INSPIRE modules, including Insurance Verification, Billing, Cash Management, Billable Items, Charge Capture, Reporting, and Center Information management
  • Gather requirements, analyze defects and enhancement requests, coordinate testing, and maintain governance and process documentation across supported applications
  • Partner with operational stakeholders to identify opportunities to improve system utilization and revenue cycle performance
  • Support implementation planning, system enhancements, release readiness, and integration initiatives across the revenue cycle application portfolio

Waystar

  • Support analysis and optimization of enterprise claims management, denial management, remittance processing, and workflow automation solutions within Waystar
  • Monitor data integrations, reporting, edit performance, and workflow effectiveness; investigate variances and coordinate resolution
  • Evaluate emerging artificial intelligence and automation capabilities and prepare findings and recommendations for review
  • Collaborate with operational and technology partners to ensure solutions support evolving business requirements and priorities

Analytics, Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Develop and enhance business intelligence, analytics, and reporting solutions that use CBO data and approved AI tools to support decision-making across RCO
  • Analyze workflows and performance trends to identify opportunities for automation, cash acceleration, denial reduction, improved quality, and labor efficiency
  • Maintain standards for reporting accuracy, system governance, process documentation, testing evidence, and operational best practices
  • Provide technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and analytical support to teammates and business partners
  • Prepare clear analyses, business cases, recommendations, and status updates for the Senior Director and other stakeholders

Qualifications

  • High school diploma / GED is required
  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field is preferred
  • Minimum of three years of progressive experience in Revenue Cycle, Healthcare Services, Ambulatory Surgery, Physician Practice Management, healthcare technology, or a related environment
  • Demonstrated experience supporting revenue cycle technology initiatives, business process optimization, system implementations, or operational improvement projects in a multi-site or enterprise environment
  • Experience collaborating with Revenue Cycle Operations, Information Technology, Data & Analytics, Application Development, and vendor partners
  • Strong understanding of end-to-end revenue cycle processes, including registration, insurance verification, billing, claims management, denial management, cash posting, refunds, and accounts receivable management
  • Advanced proficiency with SQL query development and maintenance, Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and related business productivity tools, with the ability to translate complex operational data into actionable insights
  • Experience developing and using business intelligence, data visualization, and performance reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or equivalent platforms
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets, identify trends and root causes, validate results, and develop practical recommendations
  • Experience with system governance, requirements gathering, testing, auditing, change management, documentation, and user adoption across multiple platforms and stakeholder groups
  • Knowledge of automation technologies, artificial intelligence applications, workflow optimization, and emerging healthcare revenue cycle technologies preferred
  • Strong project coordination skills with demonstrated ability to manage priorities, dependencies, risks, timelines, and deliverables
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain business, operational, and technical concepts to varied audiences
  • Ability to develop business cases, document recommendations, and influence decisions through data and subject matter expertise
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail and a commitment to sustainable solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and collaborate effectively in a cross-functional environment
  • Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with healthcare revenue cycle trends, regulatory requirements, and technology advancements

Preferred Certifications

Certified Healthcare Financial Professional (CHFP), Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR), Project Management Professional (PMP), Lean Six Sigma, or other relevant healthcare, analytics, or project management certifications preferred

CourseStorm helps Arts organizations connect people with creative learning opportunities. Our simple class registration, enrollment, and marketing tools make it easier for these organizations to deliver meaningful programs in their communities.

We’ve connected over 350,000 students with education already, and we’re growing fast! We’re seeking a curious, skilled Relationships Manager to help our customers succeed and expand our impact.

You’ll join our Customer Success team to build strong customer relationships and help them get more value from CourseStorm. You’ll learn about their programs, understand their challenges, and support the work they do in their communities. We’re looking for someone who listens well, communicates clearly, and follows through. You’ll own customer retention and revenue goals, collaborate across teams, and use AI thoughtfully to make more time for meaningful customer engagement.

Responsibilities

  • Build lasting customer relationships and understand each organization’s mission, programs, and goals.
  • Proactively help customers use CourseStorm to strengthen their education programs and serve their communities.
  • Manage renewals, including budget and pricing conversations, and meet renewal targets.
  • Identify opportunities for customers to benefit from additional features or services.
  • Monitor account health and revenue trends, address risks early, and involve teammates when needed.
  • Develop customer advocates for referrals, references, and case studies.
  • Keep CRM records accurate, with clear next steps and timely follow-through.
  • Share customer feedback to guide product and service improvements.
  • Use AI and connected tools to work efficiently while maintaining accuracy and sound judgment.
  • Manage priorities, flag blockers early, and help improve team processes.

Requirements

  • A bachelor’s degree from an accredited four-year college or university.
  • 1+ years in a dedicated SaaS customer success or account management role, preferably in EdTech.
  • Experience with and enthusiasm for AI-first workflows.
  • Proven success building customer relationships and meeting renewal targets.
  • Understanding of SaaS metrics including retention, expansion, churn, and net revenue retention.
  • Experience managing customer records and tasks in a CRM (Hubspot, Salesforce, etc.).
  • Clear communication with strong active listening skills.
  • Ability to learn software quickly and connect its capabilities to customer needs.
  • Strong organization, independent problem-solving, and dependable follow-through.
  • Empathy, curiosity, accountability, and openness to feedback and growth.
  • An interest in the Arts and the role Arts organizations play in their communities.

Helpful, but not required:

  • Experience working in an Arts organization, especially with education or community programs.
  • A customer success certification.

CourseStorm is centered around personal growth. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We know confidence gaps and imposter syndrome can keep excellent candidates from applying, and we don’t want that to keep us from meeting you.

Benefits

CourseStorm offers a competitive benefits package, including:

  • A supportive team and a culture that values work+life fit
  • Flexible remote work
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Short-term disability and life insurance
  • Retirement plan
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Paid holidays
  • Unlimited “Take What You Need” paid time off
  • Paid professional development
  • $1,200 home office budget
  • $1,000 annual personal learning stipend
  • Competitive compensation

About CourseStorm

We believe that everyone is needed to build a better world through education and we are actively working to hire a diverse staff. The unique experiences, perspectives, and talents of our team members aren’t accessories – they are instrumental to our success and the impact we make. We welcome anyone with an open mind and an open heart to join us on this journey.

CourseStorm is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, or national origin.

raw.description:
We are seeking a highly organized and customer-oriented Remote Cruise Specialist to oversee and manage the reservation process for our clients. This remote, entry level role is pivotal in ensuring a seamless booking experience while maintaining high standards of customer service and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Manage Bookings: Oversee the booking process, including reservations, scheduling, and client communications.
  • Customer Service: Provide exceptional customer service by addressing inquiries, resolving issues, and handling special requests promptly and professionally.
  • Client Relationships: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, ensuring repeat business and customer loyalty.
  • Handle Cancellations/Amendments: Manage booking changes, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring customers are informed and all updates are accurately recorded.
  • Provide Recommendations: Offer clients personalized advice, including destination suggestions, accommodation options, and transportation arrangements based on their preferences, budget, and needs.
  • Stay Updated on Conditions: Monitor global advisories, restrictions, and safety concerns, informing customers about potential risks or disruptions.
  • Offer Guidance: Advise clients on visa requirements, documentation, health precautions, and necessary vaccinations depending on destination.
  • Planning: Assist customers in creating detailed itineraries, incorporating must-see attractions, activities, and dining recommendations.
  • Cultural Insights and Tips: Provide destination-specific cultural tips, local customs, and etiquette to ensure customers have a smooth and enjoyable experience abroad.

Requirements:

  • Experience: Proven experience in a customer service, booking, or scheduling role. Experience in hospitality, customer service, or events is a plus but not required. Entry-level position and training provided.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with clients.
  • Organizational Skills: Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.
  • Problem-Solving: Capable of resolving customer issues efficiently and effectively while maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction.
  • Technical Skills: Proficient in booking software, CRM systems, and Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Time Management: Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines.

To learn more about the Accenture Products & Platforms for HR, Talent and Skilling practice, please visit our site.


The Role


As a Level 7 Software Sales Manager, you drive growth for an assigned software product or portfolio. You engage prospects and clients consultatively, manage the full sales cycle, position differentiated software capabilities, and help clients achieve measurable business outcomes. You work across product, technical, marketing, and leadership teams to build pipeline, advance opportunities, and close complex software deals.

Sales Operations & CRM

Market Awareness & Product Knowledge

  • Stay informed on evolving market trends, technologies, and competitive offerings.
  • Participate in educational sessions on product updates and development roadmaps.
  • Help clients maximize the value of software features through consultative engagement.

Performance & Negotiation

  • Meet or exceed productivity metrics as defined by the management team.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to close deals effectively.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 50% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s What You Need:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software sales; proven track record of exceeding sales metrics.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience selling to SAP customers, functional and technical experience in SAP Plant Maintenance (SAP PM) or SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience designing/executing go-to-market strategies and campaigns.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience demonstrated success in closing complex, high-value sales opportunities.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Professional Experience:

raw.description:
Position Summary

The Director Engineering Technical Expert Sterile Fill provides enterprise-level technical leadership for sterile fill engineering across AbbVie’s strategic investment portfolio, with accountability for biologics sterile filling, Annex 1-aligned contamination control, aseptic processing design, barrier technology strategy, equipment / facility interfaces, GMP readiness, validation / CQV integration and technical assurance within Strategic Investments - Engineering.

The role shapes and governs engineering strategies for strategic investments by setting technical direction, aligning standards and assuring robust execution across priority capital programs, technology platforms and future manufacturing capabilities.

The role leads engineering activities associated with strategic investment programs, including new facility investments, technology platform deployments, capacity expansion, infrastructure enablement, lifecycle asset renewal and capability-building initiatives that materially impact long-term business performance.

The role partners with Strategic Investments leadership, operating sites, quality, EHS, validation / CQV and external engineering partners to make high-quality technical decisions, resolve complex risks and deliver business-aligned engineering outcomes.

Strategic Investments - Engineering Context

Strategic Investments - Engineering provides senior technical leadership, engineering governance, standards ownership and execution assurance across AbbVie’s strategic investment portfolio.

The organization supports strategic capital programs including new manufacturing facilities, technology platform deployments, capacity expansion, infrastructure enablement, lifecycle asset renewal and future capability investments.

Strategic Investments - Engineering roles are expected to establish clear technical direction, drive enterprise alignment, transfer lessons learned and enable consistent, high-quality engineering delivery across the strategic investment portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Investments - Engineering Governance and Standards

  • Establish, maintain and deploy global engineering standards, technical practices and governance expectations for biologics sterile fill engineering, Annex 1-aligned contamination control strategy, aseptic processing, barrier technologies, equipment / facility interfaces, GMP readiness, validation / CQV integration and technical assurance.
  • Drive consistent application of technical standards, design principles, lessons learned and engineering playbooks across regions, sites and capital projects.
  • Ensure discipline strategies directly support AbbVie’s strategic investment priorities, future manufacturing capability requirements and major capital program objectives.
  • Provide governance and escalation for technical decisions with material safety, quality, compliance, cost, schedule, operability or lifecycle impact.

Strategic Investment Leadership and Execution Support

  • Provide senior engineering leadership for strategic capital investments, including new facility builds, technology platform deployments, capacity projects, infrastructure enablement, lifecycle asset renewal and future capability investments.
  • Support front-end engineering, facility concept development, investment option evaluation, manufacturing capability assessments and site / platform planning activities.
  • Partner with Strategic Investments and project leadership to ensure technical assumptions, deliverables, risks and resource needs are integrated into capital program plans.
  • Apply enterprise lessons learned and strategic investment standards to improve project quality, decision speed, reliability and readiness across the portfolio.

Sterile Filling, Biologics Manufacturing and Annex 1 Compliance

  • Provide senior technical leadership for sterile filling of biologics and parenteral products, including vial, syringe, cartridge and bulk sterile transfer interfaces where relevant to strategic investment scope.
  • Ensure facility, equipment and process design decisions are aligned with EU GMP Annex 1 expectations for sterile medicinal products, including contamination control strategy, quality risk management, cleanroom classification, barrier technology and aseptic process control.
  • Govern technical strategy for isolators, restricted access barrier systems, Grade A critical zones, Grade B / C / D background environments, unidirectional airflow, first-air protection, glove systems, transfer systems and aseptic interventions.
  • Lead engineering input to contamination control strategy development, ensuring critical control points are embedded across facility design, equipment, utilities, personnel flows, material flows, cleaning, disinfection, environmental monitoring and maintenance access.
  • Partner with Quality, MS&T, Validation / CQV and Operations to ensure aseptic process simulations, media fill strategy, filter integrity testing, sterile filtration, container closure integrity, environmental monitoring and viable / non-viable particle control are considered in design and readiness decisions.
  • Provide technical challenge and risk-based decision support for interventions, line set-up, lyophilization interfaces, stopper / component handling, depyrogenation, sterilization, single-use systems, CIP / SIP interfaces and biologics product protection requirements.
  • Ensure sterile fill investment programs are designed for inspection readiness, robust contamination prevention, operational maintainability, product sterility assurance and reliable long-term biologics manufacturing performance.

Technical Leadership and Delivery

Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Senior Software Engineer, Tax Engineering

Tax Engineering sits at the intersection of every trade, every payment, and every product Coinbase ships. When a user buys Bitcoin, sells an equity, earns staking rewards, or redeems an Advisor-managed strategy, Tax Engineering is in the critical path, calculating cost basis, tracking gain/loss, determining withholding obligations, and producing compliance reporting across every product line and legal entity globally. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Tax team within the Consumer & Business group, you'll build the extensible primitives that make each new Coinbase launch possible, where scale and accuracy are both non-negotiable.

What you'll do:

  • Own the design and delivery of backend systems for cost basis tracking, gain/loss calculation, withholding automation, and tax reporting infrastructure
  • Build new pipelines for broker reporting, automated withholding, and clearing integrations with partners as Coinbase expands into equities, margin, and options
  • Partner with Product, Design, Tax, Trading, and Positions teams to take ambiguous problems from scoping through production rollout
  • Drive an extensible tax architecture so every new product launch can plug into shared primitives without bespoke rework
  • Strengthen engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship across the team

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 6+ years of backend software engineering experience building and operating production systems with high-quality, well-tested code
  • Strong distributed systems fundamentals, with experience designing high-throughput services and data pipelines where correctness is critical
  • Track record owning complex systems end-to-end, from design through production operation, in fast-changing domains
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional partners to translate ambiguous requirements into shipped solutions
  • Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Overview

Groups is a leading outpatient provider specializing in substance use disorder (SUD) treatment. We are committed to supporting underserved communities hit hardest by the opioid crisis. Since 2014, our local care teams have guided hundreds of thousands of individuals on their path to recovery, helping them reclaim their purpose and dignity through compassionate, collaborative care.

Our evidence-based approach combines medication, group therapy, and personalized support, delivered online and in person by local providers. Founded on the belief that recovery extends beyond the traditional office visit, Groups helps members build a foundation for long-term recovery and the fulfilling lives they want and deserve.

Together with our community partners, public agencies, and health plans, we are raising the bar in addiction health care—and we’re just getting started.

Groups is changing lives. Join us.

At Groups, the Recovery Access Specialist has a critical role within the Groups’ organization - serving as the first touchpoint with all our members in the member intake process and acting as a member liaison for all prospective member and current member calls.

Schedule: Monday - Friday 3p-11p EST

Pay: $19.00 - $21.00/hr

Responsibilities

Essential Functions:

  • Answering all calls within established guidelines in a welcoming, energetic manner.
  • Demonstrate knowledge of organizational structure and criteria to prospective and current members.
  • Provide educated answers to clinical questions, identify/assist caller needs, ensure all requests are followed through and completed.
  • Initiate client Biopsychosocial Assessment by utilizing motivational interviewing techniques to determine each caller's eligibility for Groups’ program.
  • Schedule initial intake appointment utilizing EMR.
  • Facilitate seamless client intake; coordinate client no-shows with clinic coordinators.
  • Provide a positive experience that demonstrates our unique culture and values to develop a therapeutic rapport with clients.

Other Duties and Responsibilities:

  • You will be required to work a minimum of 3 company holidays per year which you will be paid time and a half.
  • You will be required to work a minimum of 2 company mental health days per year
  • Other duties as assigned based on the business needs.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • A friendly but clear phone communication style.
  • A strong communicator: you possess the ability to communicate effectively on the phone with clarity and warmth
  • Critical thinking and judgment skills - you can read between the lines to determine if an issue requires special or urgent attention.
  • Enthusiasm to learn the best practices to treat opioid dependency.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks and work in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong telecommunication skills and comfort while working in multiple IT systems, applications and tools.
  • Strong customer service orientation required.
  • A people person: You enjoy connecting with people from diverse backgrounds and help people feel at ease
  • Compassionate: you have empathy for those trying to navigate a difficult health situation and are dedicated to helping improve their experience through your stewardship
  • Organized: you feel confident handling a high volume of incoming calls efficiently but thoroughly address each one as if it were the most important caller of the day
  • Exceptionally positive: you believe that practicing patience and employing a positive attitude will help improve any situation
  • Passionate about our mission: you are looking to join a mission-driven team and culture, and are willing to go above and beyond to get the job done.
  • Ability to work independently under general supervision.
  • Ability to understand and adhere to the Code of Conduct.

Qualifications

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's degree preferred
  • Minimum 1-year experience in human services/healthcare or customer service professional role; retail, medical, or hospitality experience preferred.
  • Access to reliable internet and telephone services, specifically a 10M download and 5M upload package or highe,r as well as a strong WiFi signal from your remote work location.
  • Must meet pre-employment requirements and maintain all applicable state and job-related guidelines for background screening. Depending on state-specific requirements, this may include fingerprinting, drug testing, health screening, CPR/Basic First Aid, and license/credential verifications.

These physical demands are representative of the physical requirements necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodation can be made to enable people with disabilities; these are made on a case-by-case basis.

While performing the responsibilities of the role, the employee is required to talk and hear. The employee is often required to sit and use his or her hands and fingers. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk and reach with arms and hands. Vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

About the Role

We are seeking a Middle UI/UX Designer to join our design team. In this role, you will create intuitive, user-centered, and visually compelling experiences for AI-driven platforms, mobile apps, and web applications. You will work closely with product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to develop solutions that balance user needs and business goals. You will also get to design for products across all sorts of industries and platforms, making this an exciting place to exercise your design muscles.

This role requires a high level of creativity, collaboration, and attention to detail. The ideal candidate has a strong background in UI/UX design, an eye for aesthetics, and a passion for delivering exceptional user experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design process from concept to implementation for individual clients and NineTwoThree projects following industry best practices and company procedures.
  • Deliver well-structured Figma boards with components, symbols and brand styles that remain consistent throughout the design process and have a single source of truth for all elements that update entire systems.
  • Develop wireframes, interactions, and high-fidelity UI designs using Figma.
  • Create prototypes when delivering design ideas to illustrate different design solutions and test hypotheses.
  • Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate complex requirements into user-friendly designs.
  • Prepare high-quality, developer-ready designs covering most edge cases and ensure smooth handoff to engineering teams, providing specs, assets, and documentation as needed.
  • Explore ways to optimize the design process, including using AI tools, and share findings with the team
  • Present and explain design ideas to teammates and clients, grounding your rationale in user needs, business goals, and established design principles.
  • Participate Actively in multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Stay updated with UI/UX standards and guidelines to ensure our applications are intuitive and follow familiar patterns.

Requirements

Requirements

  • At least 3 years as a UI/UX Designer, with a portfolio that shows user flows, usability and visual design for established brands.
  • Experience designing for AI-driven applications.
  • Experience designing responsive mobile and web apps, and working knowledge of Material Design and Apple's Human Interface Guidelines.
  • Strong visual fundamentals: typography, composition, layout, grids and colour, with close attention to detail.
  • Advanced Figma: team libraries, auto layout, component properties and prototyping.
  • Experience contributing to a shared design system and giving and receiving design feedback.
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced agile environment with clear processes, tight deadlines and several projects at once.
  • Clear written and spoken communication, working remotely and asynchronously across departments.
  • Upper-Intermediate English (B2) or higher.

    Will be an advantage:
    • Hands-on use of AI tools, such as Claude, Cursor or Codex, in the design workflow.
    • Experience building working prototypes in code with AI tools such as Claude or Cursor (React, Next.js, Tailwind).
    • Interaction design experience: states, transitions between steps, feedback and edge cases.

You’ll Thrive If You:

    • Enjoy designing non-trivial web apps
    • Like to be challenged and learn fast
    • Can work independently through the full design cycle
    • Communicate clearly in writing and through presentations

You Might Struggle If You:

    • Take weeks to deliver results
    • Are not used to feedback from Product Managers, Engineers and QAs
    • Rely solely on visual aesthetics or general design trends

About Lyra Health

Lyra Health is a leading provider of evidence-based mental health care, serving more than 20 million people globally in partnership with employers and more than 100 million through health plan and partner relationships. The company has delivered more than 15 million sessions of mental health care, published more than 35 peer-reviewed studies, and delivered unmatched outcomes in terms of access, clinical effectiveness, and cost efficiency. Extensive peer-reviewed research confirms Lyra’s transformative care model helps people recover twice as fast and results in a 26% annual reduction in overall healthcare claims costs. Lyra is transforming access to life-changing mental health care through Lyra Empower, the only fully integrated, AI-powered platform combining the highest-quality care and technology solutions.

About the Role

Lyra Health is looking for a strategic and AI-savvy storyteller to reimagine how we create, manage, and scale compelling narratives across the full pursuit journey, from the initial RFP through finalist presentations and deal closing. Combining sharp writing, strategic messaging and process discipline, you'll help our Sales and Customer Success teams tell stronger, buyer-centric stories that communicate Lyra's value.

Sitting within Lyra’s Solution Marketing team, you’ll lead Lyra's proposal content strategy, strengthening the quality and impact of our RFPs. You'll own the messaging foundation within our proposal response platform, while putting emerging AI capabilities into practice to improve first-pass drafting, personalization, and quality.

Beyond proposals, you'll help shape how generative and agentic AI transform content development across Marketing and Sales. Working closely with Product Marketing, Segment and Solution Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success, you'll experiment with new technologies and develop smarter, more scalable approaches that improve efficiency and storytelling effectiveness across the full pursuit journey.

Responsibilities

  • Translate complex product capabilities, clinical outcomes, and value propositions into compelling, differentiated narratives tailored to buyer needs, segments, and business priorities.

  • Apply generative and agentic AI to rethink content workflows, improving how teams discover, draft, personalize, and refine content while reducing manual effort and strengthening response quality.

  • Experiment with emerging AI technologies to create more connected, scalable content experiences across the pursuit journey, from market narratives and RFP responses to finalist presentations, ensuring a consistent and compelling story of Lyra's value.

  • Own the content strategy, architecture, and quality of Responsive, ensuring our proposal knowledge base reflects Lyra's latest positioning, product capabilities, and proof points. Manage governance and content standards that improve AI retrieval, response accuracy, and overall quality.

  • Turn recurring RFP questions, buyer priorities, and content gaps into actionable insights that strengthen Lyra's positioning, connect messaging across the pursuit journey, and more clearly communicate our value to buyers.

  • Partner with Proposal Managers, Writers, Product Marketing, Segment and Solution Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success to close messaging gaps, establish content validation processes, and develop stronger, reusable narratives across the pursuit journey.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years in content strategy, product marketing, solution marketing, proposal content, or a related field, with a strong foundation in positioning, messaging, and persuasive business writing.

  • Demonstrated experience applying generative and agentic AI capabilities to content development, with curiosity and enthusiasm for experimenting with new tools, workflows, and approaches.

  • Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to simplify complex information, articulate differentiation, and create compelling narratives for business audiences.

  • A proactive, experimental mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities, challenge existing approaches, and turn new ideas into practical improvements.

  • Demonstrated experience both using and managing proposal management platforms such as Responsive, including hands-on ownership of content libraries, knowledge architecture, content governance, and AI-powered response capabilities.

  • Strong understanding of the RFP and complex sales process, including how messaging, positioning, buyer priorities, and competitive differentiation influence a pursuit.

  • Experience developing and maintaining reusable content that can be adapted for different audiences, segments, and use cases.

  • Strong strategic judgment, with the ability to evaluate not only whether content is accurate, but whether it is relevant, persuasive, and effective.

  • Ability to translate complex product, technical, or industry information into clear, customer-focused messaging.

  • Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience partnering with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, and other stakeholders to align messaging and content priorities.

  • Experience in health care, benefits, or another complex or regulated industry is a plus.
