At Gurobi Optimization, we're on a mission!
A mission that focuses on mathematical optimization. We empower our customers to expand their use of mathematical optimization technology in order to make smarter decisions and solve some of the world's toughest and most impactful business problems. We're looking for passionate, dedicated, innovative game-changers to join our team and drive the future of Gurobi.

As a Security Engineer at Gurobi Optimization, you will offer direct security support for both infrastructure and end-user systems and services. Our workplace primarily uses macOS endpoints, and our infrastructure includes cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and a Colo datacenter. Our employees are spread out in 16 countries around the world, so although the company is small, our security needs are complex.

What will you be doing?

  • AI Governance

  • Monitor developments in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity to identify emerging risks and opportunities for improving security controls.

  • Utilize CrowdStrike and related security platforms to collaboratively identify, monitor, and mitigate risks associated with the use of AI applications and services.

  • Work with the team to audit and update the configuration of AI platforms to adapt to evolving data leakage and similar threats.

  • AWS/Colo

  • Manage configuration and updates to critical security systems such as firewall and network.

  • Certificate deployment, renewal, and management through Infrastructure as Code (IaC)

  • Office365

  • Suggest, review and help implement highly secure configuration standards.

  • Enhance and oversee Phishing/Virus Detection and response measures.

  • Assess and deploy features to enhance security for end-user accounts and services.

  • Vendor Security Assessments

  • Assist with assessments from customers interested in Gurobi products.

  • Audit Observations

  • Review audit findings and collaborate on implementing necessary changes in response.

  • Assist in upcoming certification efforts.

  • Vulnerability Management

  • Conduct Port Scanning and Perimeter Scanning to identify vulnerabilities.

  • Assist with patch reporting and enforcement for laptops, servers, and virtual machines.

  • 3rd Party Apps Review/Assessment

  • Assess requests for new 3rd party applications, ensuring vendor compliance with our safety and security standards.

  • Consolidate services and applications under Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) and Single Sign-On (SSO) solutions.

  • Endpoint Security Management

  • Maintain standards for Mac and Windows laptops used globally.

  • Update and enforce acceptable use policies.

  • Develop Mobile Device Management (MDM) policies and processes.

What experience and qualifications should you have?

  • A degree in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent relevant professional experience.

  • Five years of hands-on experience in security engineering, security administration, infrastructure security, or a closely related role.

  • Active participation in the cybersecurity community through professional organizations, conferences, training, certifications, research, or knowledge sharing.

What skills and abilities should you have?

  • Thorough understanding and expertise in computer systems, networks, cloud technologies, applications, and security systems.

  • Experience managing security systems in CrowdStrike and Microsoft Purview

  • Excellent presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills.

  • Robust analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Proficiency in working collaboratively across different functions and teams.

  • Capability to operate effectively across various global time zones within a 100% remote work environment.

What other requirements should you have?

  • Proficiency in cloud infrastructure, Linux, virtualization technologies, and infrastructure automation.

  • Experience with LDAP, Docker, GIT, JumpCloud, and Microsoft 365.

Your Alignment with our Gurobi Core Values:

  • Customer Focus: Verbal & written communication skills that bring clarity and build trust.

  • Power of the Team: Motivated with a team-oriented mindset that aims to both inspire and be inspired by others.

  • Innovation: The courage to bring ideas forward and see yourself as an integral part of our global team.

  • Dedication: Organized and agile, focusing on meeting professional objectives while promoting a healthy work/life balance.

  • Integrity: Promise to uphold honesty as your compass and conduct all business practices with an ethical mindset and fiscal responsibility.

Gurobi Optimization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
Gurobi Optimization is an E-Verify employer. As part of our hiring process, we utilize the federal E-Verify program to verify the employment eligibility of all newly hired employees. For additional information regarding E-Verify, please visit .

Job Title: Epidemiology Study Operations Manager

Job Location: North Chicago, IL

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:


Company Description

About AbbVie

AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at . Follow @abbvie on LinkedIn,Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.


Job Description

Purpose:

This position reports into the Clinical Sciences (CS) Product Office within the Clinical Science organization’s Global Strategic Operations. The CS Product Office, Product Safety Team (PST) and Epidemiology organizations work collaboratively and strategically with colleagues across the product lifecycle to identify, evaluate, understand and communicate the safety profile of our drugs to protect patients worldwide.

The PST is a high-profile high-impact team that leads and owns safety decisions and strategy across the product lifecycle. The team partners with stakeholders across the product lifecycle to provide innovative safety-driven strategies, which will maximize product benefit-risk for patients. The CS Product Office plays a critical role in shaping and driving the priorities of the PST by providing strategic and operational leadership oversight of the PST model.

As an Epidemiology Study Operations Manager within the CS Product Office, you will support and partner with the Global Epidemiology organization to achieve its mission in managing the lifecycle of studies utilizing real world evidence and to ensure compliance with quality standards (Global Regulations and AbbVie policies and procedures).

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic management and oversight of Epidemiology-led non interventional studies with progressive autonomy
  • Provide support to the Study Leader for vendor selection, scope development, management, and oversight of external vendors/CROs
  • Manage and coordinate the development of study-related deliverables including development of project plans/timelines, confirming accountabilities, document quality, driving completion of actions and escalating obstacles/risks
  • Drive study-related deliverables to ensure regulatory and process timelines are met
  • Responsible for relevant updates to the cross-functional team and stakeholders on study status
  • Leverage applicable systems and processes to enable successful tracking and completion of the study and study-related deliverables
  • Coordinate the development, review and approval of study protocol and other study-related documents
  • Maintain study-related documents (e.g., meeting minutes, IRB/EC approvals) in the appropriate document repository
  • Responsible for oversight of funds spent against approved budget
  • Proactively identify, address and escalate, as appropriate, project-related issues
  • Identify opportunity areas for efficiency and participate in department related projects in order to achieve operational excellence within Global Epidemiology and the CS Product Office
  • Build solid foundation in understanding regulations and applies knowledge or regulations to guide the development study-related deliverables
  • Collaborate effectively to build and leverage relationships across functions and organizations to achieve business results
  • Participate in audit and inspection preparation and execution activities

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in biological/medical science or healthcare professional
  • 6+ years of experience working in healthcare, research institution, or pharmaceutical industry
  • A minimum of 2 years driving project management activities or operational experience within global companies
  • Preferred experience in one of the following areas: drug development, non-interventional study lifecycle management, risk management, and/or Pharmacovigilance
  • Demonstrated ability to work and collaborate with others to build/leverage relationships
  • Ability to adopt process and technology changes
  • Familiarity with medical and study terminology and concepts is desirable
  • Proficiency in computer skills (Windows, Word, Excel) and in databases (e.g., clinical trial management system)

Additional Information

Applicable only to applicants applying to a position in any location with pay disclosure requirements under state or local law: ​

  • The compensation range described below is the range of possible base pay compensation that the Company believes in good faith it will pay for this role at the time of this posting based on the job grade for this position. Individual compensation paid within this range will depend on many factors including geographic location, and we may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range. This range may be modified in the future. ​
  • We offer a comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off (vacation, holidays, sick), medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.​
  • This job is eligible to participate in our long-term incentive programs.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, incentive, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole and absolute discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole and absolute discretion, consistent with applicable law.​

AbbVie is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to operating with integrity, driving innovation, transforming lives and serving our community.  Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled.

raw.description:
About the company

Paid per approved task, about $35/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $35/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

JOB SUMMARY

Oversee and ensure the overall profitability of the regional operations center. This includes but is not limited to reaching and exceeding financial & referral goals, properly managing staffing efficiencies throughout the team, managing performance expectations & improvements for existing staff. Present management with regular reporting on any topic requested by the management team.

  • Business experience in a Worker’s Compensation and/or Auto insurance setting is preferred.
  • Long Term / Short Term Disability Claims background is preferred.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsible for the overall production, performance, and quality of the assigned region.

● Plans and organizes daily activities related to production and operations.

● Measures productivity by analyzing performance data, financial data, and activity reports.

● Coordinates with other support departments such as human resources, finance, and IT and BA to ensure successful production operations.

● Determines labor needs to meet production goals.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

● Organizes and oversees the schedules and work of assigned staff.

● Conducts performance evaluations that are timely and constructive.

Other duties as assigned.

JOB RELEVANT EXPERIENCE:

Business experience in a Worker’s Compensation and/or Auto insurance setting is preferred.

Long Term / Short Term Disability Claims background is preferred.

JOB RELATED SKILLS/COMPETENCIES:

WORKING CONDITIONS/PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

This job description is subject to change at any time.

Requirements

Beginning compensation will depend on several factors, including the candidate's experience, education, and specific skills. In addition to the base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, retirement plans, and performance bonuses.

Our Commitment:

We are committed to providing fair and competitive compensation that reflects each employee's contributions and performance. We value diversity and strive to create an inclusive environment for all employees.

Benefits

Join our team at Dane Street and enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being and peace of mind. We offer a range of benefits including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family. Additionally, we offer voluntary life insurance options for you, your spouse, and your children. We also offer other voluntary benefits which include hospital indemnity, critical illness, accident indemnity, and pet insurance plans. Employees receive basic life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability coverage at no cost. Our generous paid time off policy ensures you have time to relax and recharge, while our 401k plan with a company match helps you plan for your future. Apple equipment and a media stipend are provided for remote workspace.

ABOUT DANE STREET:

A fast-paced, Inc. 500 Company with a high-performance culture, is seeking insightful forward-thinking professionals. We process over 200,000 insurance claims annually for leading national and regional Workers’ Compensation, Disability, Auto, and Group Health Carriers, Third-Party Administrators, Managed Care Organizations, Employers, and Pharmacy Benefit Managers. We provide customized Independent Medical Exams and Peer Review programs that assist our clients in reaching the appropriate medical determination as part of the claims management process.

About Alleyoop

Alleyoop is a beauty brand built around easy, effective makeup, sold direct to consumers through our website, and through retail partners and TikTok Shop. Creators are central to how we tell our story and grow, and our marketing team is expanding to support that.

About the role

Reporting to the Social Commerce Director, you will handle the day-to-day work that keeps our creator community active and our content flowing, across Trybe, TikTok Shop, LTK and social.   • Manage creator communication and follow-ups across Trybe, TikTok Shop, LTK, email and social dms.
  • Review creator-submitted content for brand fit and flag top performers for paid ads, and organic social.
  • Coordinate sample shipments and gifting, including manual orders.
  • Collect and track creator contracts and usage rights; keep creator footage organized and labeled for the creative team.
  • Maintain creator trackers and Notion databases with accurate, current information.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Comfort with Google Workspace, and a quick learner of new tools

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with creator/affiliate platforms.

raw.description:
As a Customer Success Manager, you have the opportunity to serve, help and guide auto repair shop owners in digitally transforming their businesses with Shopmonkey. In this position, you will lead Shopmonkey’s customer expansion initiatives. You are responsible for building relationships with customers, mitigating churn, building towards expansion, and driving adoption and engagement with key value-add products and features.

You have the Opportunity to:

  • Learn all about the Shopmonkey product suite, our customer's journey, and automotive industry
  • Empathize with customers, understand their needs and challenges from their POV, recommend and take action on areas where we can help
  • Identify areas of the software that our customers are engaging in, drive deeper adoption, up-sell and cross-sell additional products and services
  • Ensure customers are engaged and proactively engage in churn mitigation efforts
  • Monitor and evaluate the the health of our customer base, ensuring customers renew their subscription on an ongoing basis
  • Work cross-functionally with Sales, Support, Product and Implementation teams to ensure clean handoffs and exceptional customer experience.
  • Maximize the tools available to improve efficiency and reporting, keeping the team on track for growth targets and mitigating churn
  • Communicate thoughtful, customized solutions that help customers move forward and grow their business
  • Visit customers and attend events/trade shows as required

We are looking for People who:

  • Have a clear, professional, friendly and informative communication style
  • Have a deep sense of empathy and experience in a customer-facing roles
  • Enjoy creative problem solving, being resourceful, and experiencing new and different challenges everyday
  • Show a passion for SaaS B2B, are life-long learners, and highly motivated to excel
  • Thrive in a dynamic & collaborative startup environment, and are comfortable with ambiguity and seizing opportunity.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and evolving customer needs
  • Have a related education background (Bachelor’s degree preferred)
  • Experience using tools such as Salesforce, Intercom, Totango, Pendo is a plus
  • As a nice plus, truly appreciate cars and/or are familiar with the automotive industry
  • Experience managing customers at various life cycle stages
  • Experience supporting SAAS products
  • Experience being a "product expert" and guiding customers on best practices

In the United States the range is typically a salary of $60,000 to $75,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. The range provided is Shopmonkey’s reasonable estimate of the base compensation for this role. The actual amount will be based on job-related and non-discriminatory factors such as location, experience, training, skills, and abilities. Consult with your Recruiter during the initial call to determine a more targeted range based on these job-related factors. In addition to this base compensation company stock options and benefits as outlined below are included.

Why Shopmonkey?

Shopmonkey has become an amazing environment where employees feel that they are valued as people, and not just worker bees. To ensure that our team thrives, we invest in the following perks (benefits below are mainly for U.S. based, full-time employees). Other benefits vary upon location outside of the United States, and employment status:

💪🏼 Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance benefits available the 1st of the month following hire date
  • Short term and long term disability
  • Employee assistance program
  • Reimbursement for a personal health and wellness membership
  • Generous parental leave
  • 401(k) available upon hire

✈️ Time Off

  • 11 paid holidays
  • Flexible time off - take the time off you need!

🥰 Giving Back

  • Matching donations for approved charitable organizations
  • Group volunteer efforts

Check out our founder’s story, life page, or hear from real employees about what it’s like to work at Shopmonkey.

Join our team of hungry, humble, smart people who love what they do, and change the auto industry by helping every shop thrive.

About the Industry

The U.S. is the second largest passenger vehicle market with more than 260 million registered passenger vehicles, and the global car repair market is estimated to be worth more than $500B. Shopmonkey aims to change the status quo and enable auto shops to become more efficient and give their customers a more delightful experience.

About Shopmonkey

Shopmonkey is the leading auto-repair shop software company; it is a cloud-based solution that helps auto-repair shops consolidate tools, save time, and streamline their entire operation onto a simple, easy-to-use platform.

Headquartered in Silicon Valley and trusted by more than 3,500+ auto shops across the U.S. and Canada, Shopmonkey aims to change the status quo of the car repair market, estimated to be worth more than $500B.

In 2021 Shopmonkey raised a $75 million Series C, supported by top-tier Silicon Valley venture capital firms Bessemer Venture Partners, Index Ventures, Headline, I2BF, and ICONIQ Growth.

In 2022, Shopmonkey was named #4 on Forbes' annual ranking of America's Best Startup Employers list (and #1 in Business Products & Software Services). Shopmonkey was once again named as one of America's Best Startup Employers by Forbes in 2023, 2024, and 2026!

raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Your Impact

  • Ability to work in partnership with your respective geography’s leadership to engage the SASE portfolio to customers, partners, and colleagues
  • Perform high-level sales planning, leading to accurate forecasting of the business
  • Build a fundamental understanding of security threats, solutions, security tools or network technologies
  • Bring to bear all cross-functional resources to achieve your quota.
  • Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services
  • Conduct in-person sessions, webinars and learning materials that can be consumed by the appropriate audience
  • Identify cross-selling and up-selling opportunities within accounts
  • Educate customers and partners on the modern network security landscape
  • Establish relationships with and sell through channel partners
  • Travel 50% + throughout the territory and to company-wide meetings

Qualifications

Your Experience

  • Consider yourself technical enough to cover some accounts while your SE is busy assisting others
  • Above quota sales experience in a high-tempo culture
  • Experience selling network infrastructure-based security appliances including, but not limited to - Firewalls, SSL/IPSec VPNs, Security Proxies and Caches, SD-WAN
  • Practical experience working with routing and switching products that will be installed adjacent to our appliances
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, both written and verbally
  • Experience working with Channel partners and understanding of a channel centric go to market approach
  • Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction

Additional information

The Team

Our sales team members work hand-in-hand with large organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire, and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

As part of our sales team, you are empowered with unmatched systems and tools, constantly updated research and sales libraries, and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. As a member of our sales team, you are motivated by a solutions-focused sales environment and find fulfillment in working with clients to resolve incredibly complex cyberthreats.

raw.description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD, we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD, we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists(LP, CPC, CMFT, LIMHP) in Nebraska to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

  • Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform
  • Manage your caseload and schedule
  • Maintain complete and timely clinical documentation using the NOCD EHR system
  • Participate in NOCD clinical consultation, training, and advance your knowledge and practice of evidence-supported treatments for OCD
  • Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

  • See credentialing information here.
  • Full Time Providers:
    • 40 hour work week
    • Complete 25 hours of direct clinical work per week
    • Attend a world-class training program developed by industry leaders.
    • Attend 2 hours of weekly group clinical consultation
    • Have 10 hours of weeknight/weekend availability after 5pm local time for Member Sessions
    • Will participate in and complete cross-license application process during Onboarding
    • Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training
  • Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).
    • If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.
    • Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

  • Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.
    • Masters Degree Required
    • Nebraska: Licensed Psychologist, Clinical Professional Counselor, Clinical Marriage and Family Therapist, Licensed Independent Mental Health Practitioner
  • At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)
  • Knowledge and experience with treating OCD with ERP is preferable but not required
  • Organized, quick and enthusiastic learner, excellent communicator, good with time management
  • Have a confidential, private location to work remotely from with reliable internet access
  • Comfortable and efficient with using technology to communicate
  • Ambitious and ready to keep up with a goal-driven, start-up environment

What We Offer

  • A commitment to clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and proven & visible clinical outcomes.
  • Gain world-class training from experienced OCD providers to become a specialized Therapist in treating OCD and related disorders through evidence-based care.
  • A full suite of support through continued mentorship & feedback
  • Investment in new technology built to improve the NOCD Therapist experience and allow our Therapists to continue to focus on Member care.
  • Centralized scheduling
  • An investment in your personal growth through a clear career path
  • Access to NOCD Professional Development Trainings and ongoing consultation with other team members
  • One-on-one mentorship to discuss complex cases
  • Ability to work remotely from the comfort of your own home or office
  • Competitive compensation with a robust bonus program
  • Comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, vision coverage, and 401(k) match for qualifying employees
  • Casual and engaging startup environment with an outstanding mission-driven team atmosphere
  • Generous PTO

• Job Title: Kooth Engagement Lead
  • Reports to: Senior Kooth Engagement Lead
  • Location: UK (Remote)
  • Company: Kooth Digital Health

About Us:

Kooth is a fast-growing, mission-driven organisation transforming access to digital mental health support across the UK and US. Listed on the London Stock Exchange (AIM: KOO), our mission is to create welcoming, accessible spaces for personalised mental health care that helps young people thrive.

With 25 years of experience, Kooth has become a trusted leader in digital mental health, working alongside the NHS, government partners, and local communities to make high-quality support more accessible to young people.

Building on this foundation, we've expanded Soluna, our innovative digital mental health platform, across both the US and UK. First launched in California in 2024, Soluna has since expanded into New Jersey and Michigan. In September 2026, we reached another exciting milestone with the launch of Soluna by Kooth in the UK, bringing together our experience and innovation across both markets. Through professional mental health support, moderated peer communities, and self-guided tools, we're helping young people access the support they need, when they need it.

At Kooth, we're more than a digital mental health platform. We're purpose-driven, people-centred, and grounded in our values: Alongside You, Flexible, Compassionate, Committed, and Safe. If you're looking for meaningful work with measurable impact, you'll find it here.

Learn more at Kooth and Soluna.

What We’re Looking For:

The Kooth Engagement Lead is responsible for driving awareness, uptake, and sustained usage of Soluna by Kooth (for children and young people) and Qwell (for adults, where applicable).

Operating primarily through a digital and virtual-first community engagement strategy, this role acts as the dedicated Engagement Lead for specific contracted areas, while also collaborating flexibly across local, regional, and national levels. You will build repeatable, scalable engagement pathways through live virtual sessions, webinars, asynchronous resources, pre-recorded content, and self-serve toolkits across both youth and professional/referrer audiences.

Beyond direct engagement delivery, you will play an active role in elevating outreach approach, quality and team best practice.

How You’ll Make an Impact:

Virtual Engagement & Outreach (CYP & Education)

  • Digital Assembly & Session Delivery: Plan and deliver engaging, high-impact virtual assemblies and presentations directly to children and young people (CYP) in secondary schools, colleges, and higher education settings.
  • Selective In-Person Outreach: Deliver high-value in-person engagement (such as major community events or Freshers' Fairs) on an occasional, strategic basis where maximum impact is guaranteed.

Professional, Referrer & Community System Integration

  • Flexible Delivery Models for Professionals: Promote Soluna and Qwell through adaptive formats including live virtual delivery, pre-recorded material , and self-serve partner toolkits to fit around the scheduling demands of educators, healthcare staff, and community leaders.
  • Educator & Staff Upskilling: Deliver concise virtual awareness sessions and asynchronous resources to teaching staff, school leaders, and pastoral teams to encourage signposting and service uptake.
  • Healthcare & Community Referral Pathways: Drive service uptake and signposting for Soluna and Qwell by partnering with key healthcare and community referrers including GP surgeries, CAMHS, A&E, Family Hubs, and local leaders to embed both platforms into local care pathways.
  • Parent & Carer/ Trusted Adult Awareness: Deliver virtual information sessions and distribute digital communications to build trust and awareness among parents and carers. Ensure that parents and carers/ trusted adult resources are embedded within referrer
  • Regional Network & Stakeholder Representation: Represent the organisation at critical regional network meetings to present Soluna and Qwell, liaising with Line Managers and Relationship Managers to ensure appropriate service representation.

Webinar Strategy & Delivery

  • National & Regional Webinar Hosting: Co-host and deliver national and regional webinars targeting young people, parents/carers, educators, and healthcare professionals as a core channel of virtual strategy delivery.
  • Webinar Content Adaptation: Tailor webinar content and interactive features to suit specific audience needs, commissioner priorities, and contract campaign themes.

Strategic Alignment, Cross-Regional Support & Commissioner Collaboration

  • Dedicated Contract Lead & Cross-Regional Delivery: Serve as the main engagement contact for dedicated contract areas while working flexibly across regions and nationally to share best practice, support peer contracts, and deliver multi-region initiatives.
  • Commercial & System Alignment: Collaborate closely with internal teams, particularly the Commercial team, to ensure local engagement plans align with commissioner KPIs, priorities, and regional population goals.
  • Reporting & Reviews: Prepare clear, data-led engagement summaries and reports; present findings directly during quarterly commissioner review meetings.
  • Target & Contact Sourcing: Proactively source and verify new contacts across healthcare, education, and third-sector organisations, ensuring key stakeholders are captured directly within company systems.

Practice Development & Team Collaboration

  • Active Practice Development: Actively participate in practice development groups, trial innovative virtual delivery methods, refine presentation materials, and contribute to continuous service improvement across the engagement team.
  • Team Contribution: Engage actively in team meetings, sharing local insights, peer-mentoring, and fostering a collaborative team culture.

CRM & Operational Excellence

  • Data & CRM Hygiene: Maintain up-to-date, accurate records of all outreach, contact sourcing, and engagement activities in HubSpot and designated internal tracking tools.
  • Data-Driven Strategy: Analyse monthly performance data to refine and adapt virtual outreach approaches in agreement with your Line Manager.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) & Breakdown of Focus

  • Direct CYP Outreach & Webinars (Virtual-First & Digital Toolkits): 45%
    Delivering live virtual assemblies, national/regional webinars, pre-recorded promotional rollouts, and digital student campaigns.
  • Referrer & System Upskilling (Education, Health, Community): 30%
    Delivering live virtual training, professional webinars, pre-recorded briefings, and self-serve toolkits to school staff, primary care/GP teams, CAMHS, Family Hubs, and community leaders.
  • Strategic Alignment, Commissioner Reporting & Commercial Co-working: 15%
    Quarterly review reporting, cross-regional project support, partner meeting presentations, and strategy alignment with Commercial colleagues.
  • Practice Development & Team Participation: 5%
    Actively contributing to practice development initiatives, trialling new outreach methods, and participating in team meetings.
  • CRM, Data & Administration (HubSpot): 5%
    Sourcing contacts, recording engagement metrics, maintaining database hygiene, and monthly planning.

Requirements

What You’ll Bring:

  • Proven experience in virtual delivery, online training, webinar hosting, or public speaking to diverse audiences (young people, educators, healthcare professionals).
  • Ability to design and utilise flexible delivery models (live virtual, webinars, pre-recorded modules, and self-serve toolkits) tailored to both youth and professional referrer audiences.
  • Adaptability to manage dedicated contract responsibilities while seamlessly collaborating across regional and national projects.
  • A collaborative mindset with a desire to contribute actively to team meetings and practice development groups.
  • Exceptional communication skills with the ability to build rapport and drive engagement in a remote environment.
  • Strong organisational skills with experience using a CRM system.
  • Experience or strong understanding of the education, youth work, mental health, or community healthcare sectors.
  • Capability to understand contract KPIs and translate data into actionable outreach strategies and clear reports.
  • Proficient and excited by the latest tech and virtual interactive tools.

Desirable:

  • Understanding of safeguarding protocols, digital health platforms, or NHS/Local Authority commissioning structures.
  • Experience working alongside Commercial or Business Development teams to support contract delivery.

Benefits

  • What You’ll Get:
  • Compensation: The base salary for this role is up to £28,860 annually. We’re committed to transparency and value our candidates time, which is why we share salary ranges in all states—regardless of local requirements. Final compensation will be based on a variety of factors, including your education, experience, skills, and overall alignment with the role.
  • Kooth offers a competitive base salary and comprehensive benefits including:
    • Generous Annual Leave: Enjoy 28 days of annual leave, in addition to public holidays, providing you ample time to recharge and spend quality moments with your loved ones.
    • Professional Development: Benefit from our yearly professional training programmes, tailored to your career aspirations and designed to enhance your skills and knowledge.
    • Financial Security: Plan for your future with our pension contributions and an annual performance-based bonus that recognises your contributions and rewards your impact.
    • Health and Well-being: Prioritize your health and well-being with our comprehensive AXA Health Insurance or Cash Plan provided by Healthshield and access to an Employee Assistance Programme (EAP). The EAP offers 24/7 telephone mental health support and access to GP consultations, ensuring your mental and physical health are taken care of.
    • Life Assurance: Gain peace of mind knowing that you're covered with life assurance, providing up to four times your annual salary to your loved ones in the unfortunate event of your passing.
    • Flexible Working: Embrace the flexibility of remote working, allowing you to create a work-life balance that suits your needs and maximizes your productivity.
    • Lifestyle Benefits: Participate in the Cycle to Work Scheme, promoting a healthy and eco-friendly lifestyle, and take advantage of our Incapacity Income Protection to safeguard your financial stability in case of unforeseen circumstances.

At Kooth, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace that values and embraces the unique contributions of every individual. We believe in equal opportunities for all, regardless of race, colour, religion, gender, gender identity or expression or sexual orientation.

Our dedication to creating a fair and unbiased environment is reflected in all aspects of our recruitment, hiring, and employment practices. We strive to provide a work environment that is free from discrimination, where every employee is treated with respect and dignity.

We are dedicated to providing reasonable adjustments to applicants and employees with disabilities or individuals who require accommodations to participate in the application process, interviews, or job-related tasks. If you require any reasonable adjustments to ensure your equal participation in our recruitment process, please inform our Human Resources team.

Your openness will allow us to work together to provide appropriate accommodations and ensure a fair and accessible application and employment experience for everyone.

Kooth plc is committed to our responsibilities for safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children, young people and vulnerable adults . We are committed to recruiting candidates who share this commitment to safeguarding, and therefore we apply robust recruitment and selection procedures to ensure that the people selected are right for the job, and that all candidates are appropriately screened prior to appointment. This will include a DBS check.

Location: US, Remote (Eastern Hours)

About BOI

BOI is the AI partner that Walmart, Coca-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth. We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home.

Your Role

Own the Technical Build

  • Own the architecture and engineering quality of every client build, from first prototype to production in the client's environment.
  • Shape solution architecture across models, clouds and platforms, and make build, buy or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. Our clients run on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client.
  • Set the engineering standards every build meets: evaluation of AI outputs, security and data governance, observability, and production reliability.
  • Build the reusable components, patterns and internal products that let each engagement start further ahead than the last.

Lead with Clients

  • Sit with client CTOs, CIOs and business executives as BOI's senior technical voice. Explain technical choices in terms of cost, risk and value, so non-technical leaders can decide.
  • Lead client security, compliance and procurement reviews, and get our systems approved to run in their environments.
  • Work forward deployed: get into client environments early, build alongside their teams, and keep building as the relationship grows.

Shape What We Sell

  • Scope and estimate builds for proposals with our Directors of Applied AI, so what we sell can be built on time and to standard.
  • Turn what we've built into case studies, reusable IP and technical thought leadership.

Build the Team

  • Lead, coach and grow our engineering team, roughly doubling it over the next year. Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously.
  • Run AI-first ways of working across engineering, with your own tools and workflows as the example.
  • Help build BOI like an owner, alongside our leadership team in the US and Europe.

What We Look For

We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities:

  • You've shipped AI systems to production at enterprise scale, inside environments with real security, compliance and data constraints.
  • You've led engineering in a consultancy, agency or other project-based environment. You're comfortable with work that changes shape every few months and with stacks you didn't choose.
  • You've founded a company or been early at a startup. You can build the team as well as the system, and you make good decisions before everything is known.
  • You explain technical choices to non-technical executives in plain language, and they leave the room ready to decide.

What We Offer

  • You'll set the technical direction of a growing AI company and shape how BOI builds in every market we work in.
  • You'll build compounding skills at the frontier of AI while others are still catching up.
  • What your team builds goes live in client systems within weeks, and you see the value it creates.
  • We're independent of every vendor, so you work across every model and cloud, building with whatever is best and swapping it when something better ships.
  • You get the freedom to prototype, experiment, and push boundaries on what's possible with AI.

Benefits

We also offer comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, hybrid working (if based out of NYC), professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high-impact enterprise transformations.

BOI is an equal opportunity employer: we celebrate diversity and welcome all backgrounds and identities.

You know that a positive work environment creates happy employees, which boosts productivity and dedication. On our team, you’ll have the support to excel at work and the resources to build a career you can be proud of.

Logistics at full potential

Strong leadership, management, and customer service are at the heart of our operations at GXO Logistics. As the Trade Compliance Senior Manager, you will lead and support the Director, Trade Compliance in the implementation and enhancement of GXO’s global trade compliance program while serving as the lead subject matter expert for the United States.

This role acts as a key regional subject matter expert, providing guidance to the business and ensuring compliance frameworks are effectively implemented and maintained.

If you’re ready to take your career to the next level, come join us at GXO!

Pay, benefits and more.

We are eager to attract the best, so we offer competitive compensation and a generous benefits package, including full health insurance (medical, dental and vision), 401(k), life insurance, disability and more.

What you’ll do on a typical day:

  • Lead the establishment and ongoing enhancement of export/import compliance standards, guidelines and monitoring procedures for GXO’s operations in the USA and in partnership with the Director, Trade Compliance and external trade compliance counsel.
  • Drive the implementation and effectiveness of ITAR / EAR, import, and customs compliance control policies, procedures, and resources through training, communication, and process improvements.
  • Proactively identify and address compliance risks, driving continuous improvement initiatives and implementing sustainable solutions.
  • Partner with operational leadership, customers and functional teams to implement practical and effective trade compliance controls.
  • Maintain compliance with DDTC registration and reporting requirements, working with internal stakeholders and external counsel as required.
  • Oversee compliance with ITAR and EAR regulated operations, driving risk mitigation and process improvements.
  • Monitor and interpret regulatory developments (ITAR, EAR, customs, sanctions), ensuring the business remains informed and compliant.
  • Provide operational and reporting support for queries related to ACE.
  • Support business units with import, export, sanctions and customs compliance matters.
  • Support the standardization of trade compliance processes and assist with trade compliance-related matters relevant to the North/South American offices.
  • Review and enhance Restricted Party Screening and Enhanced Due Diligence processes, identifying opportunities for improvement.
  • Support internal investigations into potential trade compliance issues and coordinate corrective actions where required.
  • Support and assist with other aspects of the Compliance team work as required, such as compliance audits and visits, reviews, awareness and training on the GXO Code of Business Ethics and its associated policies, anti-bribery and anti-trust.
  • The role will require travel primarily within the USA.

What you need to succeed at GXO:

At a minimum, you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent work experience
  • 7-10 years of work experience in U.S. import/export regulations and trade compliance.
  • Strong expertise in U.S. customs software and systems, ACE and EEI filings.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders across operational, commercial and corporate functions.
  • Experience with Mexico and Canadian customs frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of export regulations, ITAR and EAR and customs regulations.
  • Advanced knowledge about United States economic sanctions regulations, with particular emphasis on the Office of Foreign Assets (OFAC) sanctions and general knowledge about U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry Security (BIS) and U.S. State Department, Directorate of Defense Trade Controls (DDTC) export control regulations, Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA)
  • Strong Microsoft Office skills including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Travel Requirement: up to 25% primarily within the United States.

It’d be great if you also have:

  • Free trade qualification experience (USMCA and IMMEX)
  • Knowledge of the logistics and / or supply chain business
  • Experience working with 3PL customers on import and export issues
  • Knowledge of FAR and DEFAR compliance

We engineer faster, smarter, leaner supply chains.

GXO is a leading provider of cutting-edge supply chain solutions to the most successful companies in the world. We help our customers manage their goods most efficiently using our technology and services. Our greatest strength is our global team – energetic, innovative people of all experience levels and talents who make GXO a great place to work.

At Rovia Clinical Research, we’re on a mission to bring innovative treatments to patients, improving the health and lives of our local patient communities. We believe in building a workplace where people feel supported, valued, and excited to grow their careers. Whether you’re just starting out or looking for a new path, you’ll be part of a team that truly works together and makes an impact.Our team is driven by our core values: People First, Humility, Integrity, One Team, and Results Accountability.

Position Summary:

The Clinical Research Regulatory Specialist will work as an integral member of the research staff by maintaining day-to-day regulatory tasks within the site network, assisting with the execution of clinical studies in accordance with the protocol, contract scope of work, ICH/GCP, sponsor, CRO, Rovia SOPs, and any relevant local guidelines and regulations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Performs startup activities including IRB submissions, regulatory documentation, vendor and training access, etc.
  • Assists with the management of Rovia’s eRegulatory platform Florence, including creating study binders, filing startup and maintenance documents, performing quality checks, monitoring investigator and site credentials, etc.
  • Completes regulatory documentation such as Financial Disclosure Forms (FDFs), Protocol Signature Pages (PSPs), FDA 1572s, and Investigative Brochure Signature Pages.
  • Routes regulatory documents to research staff and investigators to obtain signatures and follow up as necessary.
  • Works collaboratively with investigators and research staff to complete outstanding documents.
  • Returns regulatory documents and credentials to the sponsor/CRO in a timely manner.
  • Creates delegation of authority logs and adjusts as needed throughout the study duration.
  • Creates training logs.
  • Performs reviews of the Investigator Site Files (ISFs) for completion and accuracy.
  • Gathers documents requested during Site Selection Visits (SSVs) including copies of research staff/investigators curriculum vitae (CVs), medical licenses (MLs), Good Clinical Practice (GCP) training certificates, Rovia SOPs, site equipment calibration logs, etc.
  • Creates investigator curriculum vitaes (CVs) and updates on a biannual basis or as requested.
  • Obtains and maintains valid medical licenses for all investigators.
  • Participates in the development of company SOPs and Guidance Documents (GDs) as needed.
  • Creates and submits continuing reviews, protocol deviations, and any other ongoing IRB submissions.
  • May perform other job-related duties as requested or required.

Skills/Abilities:

  • Sound knowledge of medical terminology.
  • Sound knowledge of ICH/GCP, Regulatory requirements, FDA and HIPAA policies and practices.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to interact effectively with clinicians, patients, administrators, auxiliary personnel, regulators, monitors, and sponsors.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality.
  • Strong written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office, Microsoft Excel, and Adobe Acrobat.
  • Ability to meet multiple and changing deadlines
  • Ability to consult numerous sources for information to prepare documents.
  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Education/Experience:

  • High school diploma required, bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • 1-2 years of clinical research experience with an emphasis in regulatory and QA.
  • License/certification status with CEUs, as applicable.
  • Current GCP certification.

Role summary:
The Manager, Supply Chain Management oversees the efficient flow of merchandise through distribution networks and fulfillment centers by resolving operational issues and analyzing data to enhance network performance. This role involves collaborating with stakeholders to optimize supply chain execution, managing exceptions, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. The position requires leadership in supervising teams, fostering accountability, and ensuring compliance with company policies. The manager also champions innovation to reduce costs and improve processes while maintaining strong relationships across the supply chain to support business objectives and deliver consistent results.

The Inbound Supplier Performance team is a strategic partner across the end-to-end inbound supply chain, focused on optimizing freight flow, strengthening supplier performance, and enabling reliable execution. We collaborate across Replenishment, Operations, Transportation, suppliers, and carriers to identify barriers, resolve systemic challenges, and improve service to our stores and customers. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

Job Summary

As a Senior Consultant on the Offensive Security team, you will be a key consultant in assessing and challenging the security posture of a diverse client portfolio. You will leverage a variety of advanced tools and methodologies to act as the client's advocate for cybersecurity best practices. This role is critical in providing strong, actionable recommendations to enhance our clients' defenses against sophisticated threats.

  • Conduct comprehensive penetration tests (network, web application, cloud, mobile) to identify and exploit vulnerabilities.

  • Develop custom scripts, tools, and methodologies to automate and enhance offensive security engagements and internal processes.
  • Proactively engage with clients, clearly articulating testing approaches and methodologies to both technical and executive audiences.
  • Generate detailed reports that communicate test results, identified risks, and concrete remediation recommendations to clients.
  • Proactively collaborate with internal teams and clients, exchanging information to ensure alignment and accomplish shared security objectives.
  • Assist in scoping new opportunities and developing internal infrastructure for offensive security research and development.
  • Ability to travel as needed to meet business demands

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Portfolio Team and help build the core investment products our clients use every day.

The team owns portfolio creation, Managed Portfolios and related portfolio operations. This is product development work: you'll turn product ideas into reliable, well-built backend features that directly shape how clients invest.

You'll write high-quality code, raise the bar through thoughtful code reviews, contribute to architecture and lead projects from requirements to production. You'll work closely with Product, frontend, QA, mobile and design in a small, autonomous team with a clear roadmap.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop and maintain backend services in Python 3.11 using Django / DRF

  • Build features for portfolio creation, Managed Portfolios and portfolio operations

  • Lead roadmap projects end-to-end: clarify requirements with Product, propose the technical design, break down the work and ship it

  • Design and build RESTful APIs used by our web and mobile apps

  • Give constructive, high-quality code reviews and help raise the team's engineering standards

  • Take part in architecture discussions and contribute to technical decisions

  • Work with MySQL and Redis

  • Identify and reduce technical debt

  • Collaborate closely with Product, frontend, QA, mobile and design

  • Contribute to the evolution of our architecture and engineering practices

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience in backend development

  • Strong Python skills and solid software engineering fundamentals

  • A good understanding of software architecture and service design

  • Solid experience with relational databases and REST API design

  • A track record of writing clean, maintainable, well-tested code

  • Experience leading projects or features from idea to production

  • The ability to pick up new codebases and technologies quickly

  • Strong ownership, organisation and a collaborative working style

  • Familiarity with Git, CI/CD practices and modern engineering workflows

  • Good written and spoken English

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Django or Django REST Framework (not required, since strong fundamentals matter more than an exact framework match)

  • Experience in fintech, investing, wealth management or another regulated industry

  • Familiarity with AWS and Docker

  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools in your daily work

  • Contributions to open source or personal side projects

How We Work

We're a lean, collaborative team where engineers have real influence on architecture, technical decisions and engineering culture.

The Portfolio Team is strong and autonomous. We work in two-week sprints with Product involved throughout, and we have a clear 3–6 month roadmap. You'll have the freedom to make technical decisions and own meaningful parts of the product without micromanagement or unnecessary bureaucracy.

What We Offer

  • Impact from day one: work on core investment products used by more than 150,000 clients

  • Ownership: lead projects and become the go-to backend owner for key areas of the Portfolio domain

  • Technical growth: influence architecture and technical decisions

  • Modern tech stack: Python 3.11, Django, MySQL, Redis, AWS, GitHub, TeamCity

  • Remote-first and flexible: work from anywhere, at your own pace

  • Unlimited vacation: take time off when you need it, with no fixed limits

  • Supportive team: thoughtful, skilled colleagues who care about quality and results

Hiring Process

  1. HR interview

  2. Technical interview with the Backend team

  3. Conversation with the Portfolio team leadership

  4. Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and solve problems

About Our client

A leading provider of innovative software and services to K-12 schools and educational institutions worldwide. Their mission is to empower schools to transform education through technology. They believe in the power of education to shape the future, and are committed to helping schools prepare students for success and make a positive impact on the world.

Position Overview

Our client's events platform handles ticketing and registration on a modern, cloud-native AWS stack (ECS, Lambda, EventBridge, Aurora, DynamoDB), the most architecturally current platform in Payments. It was recently brought into the portfolio, and ownership is still transitioning from the previous team. A legacy portal and integration layer are being retired along the way. The inherited team is larger than the steady-state model the business is planning toward, with infrastructure, SRE, and DBA skills spread across generalists rather than dedicated roles. This role leads the team through the remainder of that transition and into a leaner, focused, scalable operating model, making the calls on team composition along the way.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the events engineering team through ownership transition, working toward full, independent production-deploy capability
  • Partner with the team's anchor technical leads to maintain continuity through the transition
  • Drive the team toward its steady-state target model, including an honest assessment of the current inherited team
  • Own delivery and process for the events platform, including a limited-hours, shared on-call model
  • Help retire the legacy portal and integration layer in favor of the platform's modern, native services
  • Hold regular 1:1s, give direct feedback, and build a durable team culture across a distributed team
  • Use AI-assisted development tools as part of how the team navigates and evolves a still-transitioning

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of overall experience (8+ years hands-on technical)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Comfort managing a distributed, remote team while operating primarily within US business hours
  • Strong technical fluency in a modern, containerized AWS environment: ECS, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and a managed relational database
  • Comfort reasoning about backend architecture and system-design trade-offs (service boundaries, data modeling, event-driven design) at a level sufficient to guide the team's technical decisions
  • Demonstrated expertise in at least one programming language, ideally .NET, Java, or Python
  • Experience with at least one observability platform (Datadog, New Relic, Honeycomb, or comparable)

  • Deep experience with automated testing frameworks

  • Experience assessing a larger inherited team against a leaner target

    operating model, including the people decisions that come with it
  • Working knowledge of modern CI/CD practices and production deployment safety
  • Proficiency with Claude Code, Codex, or comparable AI-assisted development tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience managing other engineers formally

  • Experience with .NET or Java specifically

  • Deep experience with AWS

  • Hands-on PCI compliance experience: familiarity with PCI-DSS requirements as they apply to the events platform's ticketing and payment workflows
  • Experience with event ticketing, registration, or similarly bursty, high-concurrency consumer-facing platforms
  • Experience retiring a legacy monolith in favor of modern, cloud-native services while the platform stays live
  • Experience managing globally distributed teams while keeping delivery aligned to US business hours

Benefits:

hireworks is cultivating a growing community of top talent across LATAM. In addition to unlocking access to positions at top tier U.S. based companies, we offer a variety of benefits to enhance your experience:

Signers National is a leading insurance platform that provides a range of brokerage and underwriting services to organizations of all sizes. Starting in 2008 as a small retail broker focused on nonprofit & human service organizations, Signers has since expanded its portfolio to include commercial real estate and transportation. Signers is a socially conscious organization boasting an amazing culture of relentless grit and continuous improvement. We go to work every day to positively affect people's lives, and we strive to do the same for our employees.

JOB SUMMARY

Individual will be responsible for the accurate and timely calculation, reconciliation, reporting, and analysis of producer commissions across the company and its member agencies. This role will leverage AI and automation tools to streamline commission processes.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Calculate, review, and process monthly & quarterly producer commissions, overrides, and bonuses in accordance with commission agreements and company policy.
    - Prepare monthly commission accruals, journal entries, and account reconciliations to support the monthly, quarterly, and yearly close processes.
    - Develop and maintain commission models and reports to support forecasting, budgeting, and strategic initiatives, including analysis of new or proposed compensation plans.
    - Support the integration of commission processes and data for newly acquired agencies.
    - Serve as a point of contact for producers, account managers, and carriers on commission inquiries, providing clear and timely resolution.
    - Maintain commission schedules, rate tables, and producer splits; ensure compliance with internal controls and audit requirements.
    - Identify and implement opportunities to automate and improve commission processes, including the use of AI tools for reconciliation, variance detection, and reporting.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or related field
    - 2-5 years’ experience in commissions, finance, accounting, or payroll, preferably within an insurance agency, brokerage, or carrier.
    - High level command of Excel (Pivot tables, XLOOKUP, formulas, charts etc.)
    - Strong reconciliation and analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy.
    - Understanding of insurance commission structures (new vs. renewal, direct bill vs. agency bill, splits) strongly preferred.
    - Strong written and verbal communication skills;
    - Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple deadlines, including month-end close.
    - Preferred: demonstrated experience using AI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude) to automate workflows, analyze data, or improve reporting accuracy and efficiency.
    - Agency management system experience (e.g., Applied Epic, AMS360) a plus.

raw.description:
About the company

Paid per approved task, about $60/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $60/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.
