WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

PRIMARY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Operations & Personnel Management Analytics Leadership
    • Serve as the finance subject matter expert for FCS’s medical oncology business in partnership with FCS’s Operations leadership team.
    • Own the analytical framework for measuring and interpreting financial performance, including definitions, key metrics, methodology, and controls.
    • Develop and refine transparent, repeatable reporting and models that explain performance and support decision-making.
  • Forecasting, Budgeting, and Planning Support
    • Lead forecasting, budgeting, and planning activities related to Operations with a key focus on clinical operating costs and provider and staffing management.
    • Build driver-based models that support annual planning cycles, in-year forecasts, and scenario analysis.
    • Partner with stakeholders to ensure assumptions are well-supported, documented, and aligned to business realities across the entire FCS clinical footprint.
  • Executive Reporting and Decision Support
    • Deliver concise, executive-ready reporting packages that summarize performance, explain results, and highlight risks and opportunities.
    • Build “so what” insights that help leadership understand what is changing, why it matters, and what actions may improve outcomes.
    • Tailor analyses for different leadership audiences.
  • Analytical and Strategic Support
    • Support the full range of analytical, reporting, and strategic needs for FCS.
    • Contribute to ad hoc analyses, business cases, profitability reviews, strategic planning efforts, and leadership requests.
    • Help prioritize opportunities to improve financial performance and strengthen visibility into key business drivers.
  • Reporting Automation, Data Quality, and Governance
    • Build and enhance repeatable reporting tools and dashboards that provide timely and accurate performance visibility.
    • Improve efficiency through automation, standardized reporting logic, and disciplined data governance including the use of AI tools to service business stakeholders directly and provide performance visibility and insights at scale.
    • Ensure outputs are auditable, scalable, and easy for stakeholders to interpret.
  • Continuous Improvement and Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner across finance, operations, and practice leadership to identify opportunities for process improvement and stronger performance management.
    • Recommend enhancements to tools, reporting routines, and analytics approaches that improve visibility, alignment, and decision support over time.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS or similar) in finance, analytics or related field preferred.
  • CPA or CFA a plus.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial modeling, or analytics, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex forecasting and budgeting initiatives in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Excellent financial modeling & problem-solving skills.
  • Executive presence and experience with presentations to various leadership levels.
  • Ability to provide strategic recommendations and influence stakeholders to make decisions.

CORE COMPETENCIES, KNOWLEDGE/SKILLS/ABILITIES:

  • Deep expertise in advanced analytics, statistical modeling, and AI/ML applications for forecasting. Mastery of Excel, Sigma/Power BI/Tableau, and financial systems (e.g., Workday, SAP, Oracle, Hyperion).
  • Financial systems experience with ability to reconcile information from multiple sources
  • Motivated self-starter that is well organized, dependable, efficient and results-oriented
  • Strong time management and organization skills with flexibility to work in a fast-paced and changing work environment

VALUES:

  • Patient First – Keeping the patient at the center of everything we do
  • Accountability – Taking responsibility for our actions
  • Commitment & Care – Upholding FCS vision through every action
  • Team – Working together, one team, one mission

Expectations for all Employees

Every FCS employee is expected to regularly conduct themselves in a professional and respectful manner, to comply with all labor laws, workplace policy and workplace practices. Employees are expected to bring issues of any forms of workplace harassment, discrimination or other potential improprieties to the attention of their management or the human resources department.

#FCS-REV

SCREENINGS – Background and drug screens

Safeguarding our patients and each other is an important part of how we deliver the best care possible to the communities we serve. All offers of employment at Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute are contingent upon clear results of a thorough background screening. Additionally, as a condition of employment, FCS requires all new hires to receive various vaccinations, including the influenza vaccine, barring an approved exemption. In addition, FCS is a drug-free workplace, and all new hires will be subject to drug testing. Medical Marijuana cards are not recognized.


EEOC

Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute (FCS) is committed to helping individuals with disabilities to participate in the workforce and ensure equal opportunity to compete for jobs. If you require an accommodation to submit a resume for positions at FCS, please email FCS Recruitment () for further assistance. Please note this email address is intended to request an accommodation as part of the application process. Any other correspondence will not receive a response.

raw.excerpt: OverviewThe Senior People Operations Compliance Analyst supports the organization’s People Operations Compliance priorities by analyzing regulatory and client-driven requirements and coordinating assigned compliance initiatives.
raw.description:
Overview

The Senior People Operations Compliance Analyst supports the organization’s People Operations Compliance priorities by analyzing regulatory and client-driven requirements and coordinating assigned compliance initiatives. This role partners with the People Team, Legal, and cross-functional stakeholders to apply and enhance established compliance frameworks, controls, and processes that support regulatory, contractual, and audit readiness. The role proactively identifies potential compliance risks, researches evolving legal and client requirements, recommends practical solutions using established guidance and precedent, and escalates complex or high-risk matters as appropriate.

Responsibilities

Emerging Risk & Regulatory Strategy

  • Monitor, analyze, and interpret evolving regulatory requirements and industry trends across U.S. and international jurisdictions.
  • Support assessment and implementation of compliance requirements in emerging areas, including:
    • AI and automated decision-making in hiring and other employment-related processes.
    • Restrictive covenants and worker classification.
    • Wage and hour regulations.
    • Employee data privacy, accessibility, and recording keeping obligations.
    • FCRA and background check compliance.
    • Translate complex regulatory requirements into practical policies, controls, and operational guidance.

Client Compliance & Risk Mitigation

  • Partner with Legal, Client Services, and business stakeholders to review and assess client-driven compliance requirements, including background check standards, contract language review, and contractual obligations.
  • Review client contracts, RFPs, and regulatory flow-down requirements to identify People-related compliance obligations and operational impacts.
  • Assess client requirements against applicable federal, state, and local employment laws and advise on compliant implementation strategies.
  • Support audits, client inquiries, and compliance attestations by maintaining documentation, controls, and evidence of compliance.
  • Assess complex or high-risk compliance matters and propose practical solutions to mitigate legal, operational, and contractual risk.
  • Analyze root causes of compliance issues and implement sustainable, scalable processes for remediation.
  • Strengthen audit readiness through improved documentation, controls, and process consistency.

Compliance Governance & Control Design

  • Contribute to the design of People compliance frameworks, including policies, standards, and internal controls.
  • Evaluate existing People processes (e.g., hiring, onboarding, transfers, terminations, and other data management processes) to identify compliance risks and control gaps.
  • Promote standardization, documentation, and control design aligned to audit requirements.

Compliance Programs & Strategic Initiatives:

  • Coordinate assigned cross-functional compliance initiatives under the general direction of People Operations Compliance leadership by completing tasks such as:
    • Support the development and implementation of updates to policies and processes across applicable jurisdictions.
    • Coordinate enhancements to existing compliance programs and policies.
    • Conduct assigned risk assessments across People processes and geographies.
    • Track deliverables, document findings, and escalate issues that require leadership review.
  • Partner with the People Team, TA, Legal, and business leaders to ensure consistent interpretation and application of compliance standards.
  • Contribute to the creation and maintenance of global People policies and procedures to ensure clarity, consistency, and compliance with legal requirements.
  • Promotes consistent implementation of People Team policies across all business units and locations, identifying discrepancies and resolving gaps as appropriate.
  • Prioritize work based on risk exposure, regulatory urgency, and organizational impact.

Compliance Process Automation & Scale

  • Document compliance requirements and partner with People Data & Tech, People Operations, and IT stakeholders to support the implementation and testing of automated compliance workflows and controls.
  • Integrate compliance requirements into HR technology, data governance, and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual effort while improving accuracy, consistency, and auditability.

Other:

  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined on annual Performance Plan.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree required or equivalent experience. Focus in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field highly preferred.
  • 5-7 years of progressive experience in People compliance, employment law, or related governance/risk roles.
  • PHR/SPHR, SHRM-CP/SHRM-SCP certifications are highly preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex compliance initiatives, regulatory implementations, or audit engagement support.
  • Demonstrated experience of laws across all 50 US states; working knowledge of Canada, Mexico, and Australia with exposure to global compliance strongly preferred.
  • Experience working with HRIS and Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS); UKG Pro and iCIMS preferred.
  • Project management skills with ability to manage stakeholders and work cross-functionally through influence.
  • Highly effective communication, collaboration, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Presents information and ideas in a thoughtful and compelling manner; is clear and concise in verbal and written communications.
  • Experience using database management, and advanced features in Excel (pivot tables, V-look ups) and manipulating large data sets.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and communicate in a fast-paced environment.
  • Shares information freely and speaks openly and honestly.
  • Seeks to understand the perspectives of others.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to proactively assess issues, problem-solve, and make sound, data-informed recommendations.
  • Advanced experience using database management, advanced Excel functionality (e.g., pivot tables, V-look ups) to analyze, validate, and manage large, complex data sets.
  • Technically proficient in MS Office Suite and Outlook and pulling data from multiple sources.
  • Excellent communication with others to exchange information.
  • Completing tasks with a high degree of latitude.
  • Ability to handle sensitive and confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
  • Making timely decisions, escalating where applicable.
  • Remembering and adhering to processes and protocols.
  • Applying established protocols in a timely manner.
  • Ensuring the accuracy, neatness and thoroughness of the work assigned with high level of detail orientation.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing, or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access/connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.

Base compensation ranges from $72,000 to $82,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs. This role is eligible for commission. OR This role is eligible for discretionary bonus consideration.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(k) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. For information about our benefits package, please refer to our Careers page.

Since this job will be based remotely, all interviews will be conducted virtually.

About MAKE

At MAKE Banking, we believe creators deserve a banking solution that gets them. One that’s fast, intuitive, and built to help them grow. We’re building the world’s first financial platform tailored to content creators — making it easier to earn, spend, and save money across borders.

MAKE was founded with a specific purpose in mind to address the underserved needs of the Creator Economy often overlooked by traditional banking while bringing forward technology, banking, and global solutions for our Creator Economy Clients.

About the role:

You'll take ownership of day-to-day payment operations, working closely with banking partners, payment providers and internal teams to ensure payments are processed efficiently, reliably and securely. You'll play a key role in improving our payment infrastructure, solving complex operational challenges and supporting our international growth.

What You'll Be Doing:

  • Own and manage daily payment operations across multiple currencies, payment methods and banking partners.
  • Monitor payment flows, investigate failed or delayed transactions and resolve operational issues.
  • Manage relationships with banks, payment service providers and payment processors, ensuring strong operational performance.
  • Drive improvements in payment success rates, processing times, transaction costs and operational efficiency.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering to launch new payment methods, integrations and payment corridors.
  • Identify opportunities to automate processes, improve payment routing and reduce operational risks.
  • Work closely with Treasury, Reconciliation, Risk and Compliance to resolve payment and settlement issues.

Company Overview

Trovata is the first new platform to manage corporate cash and liquidity in nearly 30 years. We’re replacing legacy bank portals and outdated treasury management systems (TMS). Trovata is built on a “trove of data” foundation with workflow automation using AI and stablecoins. Trovata is creating the enterprise access, utility, and distribution layer for the future of corporate cash, investments, and payments where AI agents and stablecoins converge to deliver 24/7 programmable liquidity at  global scale.

The company was founded by a longtime Controller-CFO with a vision for a better way and engineered by an experienced team from Capital One. We’re fortunate to be financially backed by a syndicate of banks, including J.P. Morgan, Wells Fargo, and Capital One.

About the role

Our team is growing! In this Customer Success Manager role, you will be part of a team that is dedicated to driving value and helping our customers achieve their goals. CSMs quarterback the customer’s onboarding, training, and renewal processes for customers in their personal book of business. As part of your duties you will have a significant opportunity to craft the customer journey, identify opportunities, and be the voice of your customers.

Total compensation commensurate with experience and location: $90,000 - $120,000 (inclusive of MBO/bonus component)

  • Own the end-to-end customer relationship for a defined book of business, including onboarding, adoption, and renewals

  • Leverage relationships, data/metrics, and team resources to proactively identify, assess, and flag risk, and collaborate with team to mitigate and address it

What Success Looks Like

  • Own and proactively manage a book of business with full accountability for customer outcomes
  • Consistently meet deadlines and follow through on commitments to customers and internal teams

ModMed Benefits Highlight: At ModMed, we believe it’s important to offer a competitive benefits package designed to meet the diverse needs of our growing workforce. Eligible Modernizers can enroll in a wide range of benefits:

United States

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits, including a company Health Savings Account contribution,
  • 401(k): ModMed provides a matching contribution each payday of 50% of your contribution deferred on up to 6% of your compensation. After one year of employment with ModMed, 100% of any matching contribution you receive is yours to keep.
  • Generous Paid Time Off and Paid Parental Leave programs,
  • Company paid Life and Disability benefits, Flexible Spending Account, and Employee Assistance Programs,
  • Company-sponsored Business Resource & Special Interest Groups that provide engaged and supportive communities within ModMed,
  • Professional development opportunities, including tuition reimbursement programs and unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning,
  • Global presence and in-person collaboration opportunities; dog-friendly HQ (US), Hybrid office-based roles and remote availability for some roles,
  • Weekly catered breakfast and lunch, treadmill workstations, Zen, and wellness rooms within our BRIC headquarters.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: ModMed is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving imposters posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote "interviews," and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from ModMed without a formal interview process, and valid communications from our hiring team will come from our employees with a ModMed email address (). Please check senders’ email addresses carefully. Additionally, ModMed will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you are receiving communications as described above, please report them to the FTC website.

About Slash

About our Client

Our client’s product is an AI voice-sensing device, a breakthrough wearable that detects the gap between what someone says and how their voice actually sounds. Rooted in Pythagorean acoustic physics and the Navarasa framework, the system functions as a state detector rather than a conventional emotion labeler. The team is a small, fast-moving team building at the intersection of emotion labeling, ancient wisdom, and measurable science.

About the Role

We are looking for a hands-on Machine Learning Engineer to take complete ownership of our full AI stack. Your primary responsibility will be expanding our speech emotion recognition (SER) model into a physics-based harmonic vocal state engine, alongside building and maintaining our dual-instance production LLM infrastructure. In this role, you will work directly with the Founder and Lead Developer with zero bureaucracy or committee oversight. We need an engineer who excels at owning problems end-to-end.

Key Responsibilities

1. Harmonic Vocal State Engine (Audio & Physics)

  • Extend our inherited 30-class speech emotion recognition (SER) model, dataset, checkpoints, and pipeline into a physics-based harmonic detection system using Fourier-derived acoustic analysis and the Navarasa framework.

  • Design and implement an in-house model validation methodology from scratch using approaches like Gemini's emotion labeling API, cross-validation on open datasets (IEMOCAP, RAVDESS), or custom ground-truth evaluation pipelines.

2. LLM Infrastructure & Operations

  • Deploy and manage a dual-instance vLLM setup on GCP (g2-standard-24 instance): GPU 0: Llama 3.1 8B for fast-lane prompts; GPU 1: Qwen 2.5 32B for reasoning-heavy prompts.

  • Own prompt engineering, output validation, Pydantic schema enforcement, retry logic, and quality monitoring across 42 production prompts.

  • Handle infrastructure scaling and migrations independently without reliance on third-party vendors.

3. Model Quality & Continuous Improvement

  • Build evaluation pipelines to detect and catch regressions before users experience them.

  • Continuously optimize and refine model performance as real-world audio accumulates from our device.


Requirements

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Audio Signal Processing:Strong proficiency in the frequency domain (FFT, Fourier analysis, spectral features) and practical experience with audio processing libraries like librosa or torchaudio.

  • Audio ML Frameworks:Hands-on experience with modern audio ML models (wav2vec2, HuBERT, WavLM) and a deep understanding of training, evaluating, and fine-tuning SER models.

Core Tech Stack:

  • PyTorch & Python:Direct experience handling model checkpoints and training loops; ability to write clean, modular, maintainable production-level code.

Infrastructure & MLOps:

  • GCP & vLLM:Experience managing cloud infrastructure and direct experience deploying and serving models via vLLM.

  • Methodology & Communication:Proven ability to design rigorous evaluation frameworks and strong written English skills for an async-first team.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing or building physics-based audio analysis systems.

  • Familiarity with the Navarasa framework, acoustic physics, or classical music/acoustic theory systems.

  • Experience using FastAPI for inference API layers.

  • Prior experience replacing or migrating away from third-party AI benchmarks or providers.

  • Genuine personal interest in sound, acoustic physics, consciousness, or the intersection of emotions and modern ML.

Hiring Process (Take-Home Assessment)

We do not conduct whiteboard interviews. Our technical evaluation is a 48-Hour Practical Assessment consisting of two deliverables:

  • SER Model Assessment:Review our inherited SER validation report and dataset documentation, providing your strategy for validation.

  • Architecture Assessment:Provide a 1-page technical evaluation of a Python file from our harmonic engine, detailing its architecture and roadmap.

raw.description:
This is a remote position.

Customer Success Manager

Job Description

Our client is looking for aCustomer Success Managerto oversee the student experience and serve as the primary point of contact for enrolled professionals throughout their journey. They operate in healthcare education and international career transition and have expanded their services beyond training to include licensing guidance, career preparation, and access to specialized professional partners.

This person will act as the connection between students and the internal operations team, ensuring that every client remains informed, engaged, accountable, and supported. The Customer Success Manager will proactively monitor progress, coordinate solutions across departments, and resolve most day to day concerns independently without requiring founder involvement.

The ideal candidate combines empathy with accountability, communicates confidently in both English and Portuguese, and is passionate about providing a personalized, concierge level experience. Success in this position will directly contribute to student satisfaction, retention, program completion, payment compliance, referrals, and operational excellence.

Responsibilities

Student Relationship Management
  • Serve as the dedicated relationship manager and primary contact for assigned students after enrollment.
  • Build trusted relationships by understanding each student’s goals, timeline, current status, and long term career objectives.
  • Respond to student messages promptly and provide same day answers whenever possible.

Client Onboarding
  • Lead each student’s initial onboarding and introduce the overall program roadmap, expectations, timelines, communication channels, and relevant departments.
  • Collect missing documents and address initial questions.
  • Conduct a second onboarding follow up to confirm that initial tasks have been completed.
  • Review upcoming milestones and introduce additional services, resources, or partners when appropriate.

Biweekly Student Success Check Ins
  • Contact every active student proactively at least once every two weeks.
  • Review academic, licensing, documentation, career, and immigration related progress.
  • Ask whether the student needs additional assistance.
  • Identify concerns, obstacles, or disengagement before they escalate.

Student Journey Planning
  • Own each student’s journey from enrollment through program completion.
  • Develop and maintain an individualized Student Success Roadmap based on the student’s goals and timeline.
  • Identify upcoming milestones, dependencies, and required actions.
  • Help students remain on track toward licensing, program completion, and career objectives.

Progress and Milestone Tracking
  • Maintain accurate records of enrollment stages, academic progress, completed exams, pending requirements, and licensing milestones.
  • Monitor documentation, fellowship participation, graduation status, and applicable immigration milestones.
  • Follow up on missing assignments, forms, payments, or other outstanding actions.
  • Confirm that required documents are submitted on time.
  • Keep accurate timelines for each active student.

Cross Functional Coordination
  • Coordinate communication between Admissions, Academic Coordination, Licensing, Operations, Finance, Marketing, Faculty, Compliance, and the Executive Team.
  • Ensure that all relevant departments understand each student’s needs and pending actions.
  • Contact the appropriate department when additional information or specialized assistance is needed.
  • Follow up internally until open matters are fully resolved.

Issue Resolution

  • Investigate student questions and concerns before they become larger problems.
  • Coordinate practical solutions with the appropriate departments.
  • Resolve routine matters independently and escalate urgent or complex cases appropriately.
  • Follow up with students until each issue is fully closed.
  • Document recurring concerns and recommend improvements to internal processes.

Student Accountability and Engagement

  • Remind students about deadlines, assignments, exams, documentation, and scheduled activities.
  • Encourage course participation and consistent engagement.
  • Motivate students during challenging phases of their journey.
  • Balance empathy with clear expectations and accountability.
  • Reinforce the connection between current responsibilities and each student’s long term goals.

Immigration Journey Coordination
  • Monitor immigration related action items without providing legal advice.
  • Confirm that students have connected with the appropriate immigration attorneys or legal partners.
  • Encourage students to begin planning early when immigration steps could affect their overall timeline.
  • Coordinate meetings with internal teams and immigration partners when necessary.
  • Follow up on pending actions and escalate delays that may affect the student’s roadmap.

Business Setup and Professional Integration
  • Identify students interested in opening or operating a business in the United States.
  • Coordinate introductions to accounting, legal, business, and other professional partners.
  • Work with Operations to arrange meetings with partners in the United States and Brazil.
  • Help students understand administrative next steps based on information provided by qualified partners.
  • Follow up on implementation progress without providing legal, accounting, or immigration advice.

Career Development and Opportunity Management
  • Identify networking, fellowship, conference, speaking, mentorship, and professional development opportunities aligned with each student’s goals.
  • Connect students with relevant alumni, faculty members, mentors, and strategic partners.

Community Engagement and Recognition
  • Share relevant updates about the United States healthcare and aesthetics industries.
  • Recognize student publications, certifications, licenses, clinic openings, promotions, awards, and professional milestones.
  • Share approved student success stories with the broader community.
  • Encourage connections and networking among students and alumni.
  • Strengthen students’ sense of belonging throughout the program.

Client Appreciation
  • Maintain an accurate birthday and milestone calendar.
  • Coordinate gifts with Operations and ensure orders are requested at least 15 days in advance.

Risk Management
  • Monitor warning signs such as low engagement, missed classes, incomplete documentation, payment difficulties, communication gaps, dissatisfaction, or repeated delays.
  • Create recovery plans before concerns escalate.
  • Coordinate internal support and monitor whether the recovery plan is working.

CRM and Documentation
  • Update the CRM after every relevant student interaction.
  • Log calls, emails, meetings, notes, decisions, commitments, and follow up actions.
  • Ensure another team member could understand the complete status of a student by reviewing the CRM record.

Reporting and Continuous Improvement
  • Prepare weekly updates covering active students, new concerns, unresolved matters, and urgent escalations.
  • Prepare biweekly reports covering student progress, at risk cases, program completion, wins, testimonials, and escalated matters.
  • Support monthly reporting on retention, satisfaction trends, recurring operational issues, and improvement opportunities.

Requirements

​

Requirements
  • Professional fluency in both English and Portuguese, written and spoken.
  • Previous experience in Customer Success, Client Success, Account Management, Student Services, Client Relations, Case Management, or another client facing function.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple students, clients, or accounts simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong organization, prioritization, time management, and follow through.
  • Proactive problem solving skills and the ability to anticipate issues.
  • High emotional intelligence and the ability to communicate with empathy and professionalism.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate documentation habits.
  • Experience working with CRM platforms and productivity tools.
  • Proficiency with Google Workspace, including Gmail, Calendar, Docs, Sheets, and Drive.
  • Ability to work independently while coordinating effectively with multiple internal teams.
  • Ability to handle sensitive client situations with discretion.
  • Commitment to delivering a premium and highly personalized client experience.
  • Comfort working in a fast paced environment where priorities may change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Communications, Healthcare Administration, Education, International Relations, or a related field is preferred.
  • Experience supporting students, healthcare professionals, international clients, or individuals navigating complex multistep processes is highly desirable.
  • Experience in healthcare, education, immigration services, licensing, professional training, or international career transition programs is preferred.
  • Previous experience in a startup, growing company, or fast paced organization is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of the United States healthcare, aesthetics, professional licensing, or education industries is a plus.
  • Professional proficiency in Spanish is a plus.

Benefits

Benefits

• Part time position.

  • 100% remote opportunity for candidates located in Latin America.
  • Meaningful work supporting healthcare professionals through important academic and career transitions.

• High level of ownership and autonomy.

  • Opportunity to collaborate with operations, education, licensing, career, and professional service teams.
  • Exposure to international healthcare education and career transition programs.
  • Opportunity to influence client experience processes as the organization continues to grow.
  • Supportive and mission driven working environment.

WHY JOIN FCS

At Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute, we believe our people are our strength and we invest in them. In addition to having a positive impact on the people and communities we serve, associates benefit from significant professional opportunities, career advancement, training and competitive wages.

Offering competitive salaries and comprehensive benefits packages to include tuition reimbursement, 401-K match, pet and legal insurance.

A LITTLE BIT ABOUT FCS

Since 1984, Florida Cancer Specialists & Research Institute & Research Institute (FCS) has built a national reputation for excellence. With over 250 physicians, 220 nurse practitioners and physician assistants and nearly 100 locations in our network. Utilizing innovative clinical research, cutting-edge technologies, and advanced treatments, we are committed to providing world-class cancer care. We are recognized by the American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO) with a national Clinical Trials Participation Award, FCS offers patients access to more clinical trials than any private oncology practice in Florida. Our patients have access to ground-breaking therapies, in a community setting, and may participate in national clinical research studies of drugs and treatment protocols. In the past five years, the majority of new cancer drugs approved for use in the U.S. were studied in clinical trials with FCS participation prior to approval.

Through our partnership with Sarah Cannon, we are one of the largest clinical research organizations in the United States. Often, FCS leads the nation in initiating research studies and offering ground-breaking new therapies to patients.

Come join us today!

PRIMARY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ancillary Services Analytics Leadership
    • Serve as the finance subject matter expert for FCS’s ancillary service lines in partnership with each service line’s leadership team.
    • Own the analytical framework for measuring and interpreting financial performance, including definitions, key metrics, methodology, and controls.
    • Develop and refine transparent, repeatable reporting and models that explain performance and support decision-making.
  • Forecasting, Budgeting, and Planning Support
    • Lead forecasting, budgeting, and planning activities related to Ancillary Services with a key focus on service-line and site-level profitability, volume drivers, patient and referral leakage, and staffing.
    • Build driver-based models that support annual planning cycles, in-year forecasts, and scenario analysis.
    • Partner with stakeholders to ensure assumptions are well-supported, documented, and aligned to business realities across the FCS ancillary footprint.
  • Executive Reporting and Decision Support
    • Deliver concise, executive-ready reporting packages that summarize performance, explain results, and highlight risks and opportunities.
    • Build “so what” insights that help leadership understand what is changing, why it matters, and what actions may improve outcomes.
    • Tailor analyses for different leadership audiences.
  • Analytical and Strategic Support
    • Support the full range of analytical, reporting, and strategic needs for FCS.
    • Contribute to ad hoc analyses, business cases, profitability reviews, strategic planning efforts, and leadership requests.
    • Help prioritize opportunities to improve financial performance and strengthen visibility into key business drivers.
  • Reporting Automation, Data Quality, and Governance
    • Build and enhance repeatable reporting tools and dashboards that provide timely and accurate performance visibility.
    • Improve efficiency through automation, standardized reporting logic, and disciplined data governance including the use of AI tools to service business stakeholders directly and provide performance visibility and insights at scale.
    • Ensure outputs are auditable, scalable, and easy for stakeholders to interpret.
  • Continuous Improvement and Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Partner across finance, operations, and practice leadership to identify opportunities for process improvement and stronger performance management.
    • Recommend enhancements to tools, reporting routines, and analytics approaches that improve visibility, alignment, and decision support over time.

EDUCATION/CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree (MBA, MS or similar) in finance, analytics or related field preferred.
  • CPA or CFA a plus

EXPERIENCE:

  • 6+ years of progressive experience in FP&A, financial modeling, or analytics, with a demonstrated track record of leading complex forecasting and budgeting initiatives in a large, matrixed organization.
  • Excellent financial modeling & problem-solving skills.
  • Executive presence and experience with presentations to various leadership levels.
  • Ability to provide strategic recommendations and influence stakeholders to make decisions.

raw.description:
Who We Are:

Clearwave Corporation is an innovative healthcare technology company based in Atlanta, Georgia that provides a complete patient-engagement platform for specialty practices. Our solutions simplify patient experiences and help practices grow and scale in our ever-changing healthcare environment, all to create a better all-around healthcare experience. With proven ROI, Clearwave improves practice revenues, reduces staff workload, and enhances the patient experience. Through self-service scheduling and check-in, patient communication, and insurance verification, Clearwave helps practices provide a digital-first, convenient, compliant, and safe experience that patients have come to expect from healthcare providers. With 95% client retention, we understand that we’re stronger when we support our customers. Clearwave is committed to superior client onboarding and ongoing client success with an unsurpassed client-partner relationship.

Overview

Clearwave is the AI Patient Engagement Platform for healthcare organizations that must adapt and scale with leaner operational teams. Founded in 2004 and based in Atlanta, Georgia, Clearwave serves more than 5,000 healthcare locations with AI Agents that work alongside client staff to drive collections, reduce administrative workload and create a seamless patient experience.

The Client Success Manager (CSM) is a critical part of Clearwave’s growth strategy. Once a client is live and out of implementation, the CSM owns the relationship and the results: driving deeper adoption, proving measurable outcomes and protecting account health. We are looking for a natural customer advocate who is data-minded, comfortable in front of executives, and energized by a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities

  • Adoption and outcomes. Drive continued adoption across modules, locations and workflows after go-live, including Voice, Clinical Intake, Reschedule Assist and Payments, guided by success plans tied to client objectives and Clearwave benchmarks.
  • Client relationships. Serve as the trusted partner for a book of 30 to 40 clients, building relationships with practice administrators, executives, operations and revenue cycle leaders, front office teams and IT.
  • Reporting and business reviews. Build and present performance dashboards and business reviews that translate portal data into business value, with revenue impact first, operational efficiency second and patient experience as the enabler of both.
  • Account health and risk. Maintain account health scores, investigate meaningful drops, flag at-risk accounts early, and coordinate with Account Management when a client is evaluating a competitor.
  • Enterprise accounts. Grow to manage enterprise and multi-location accounts within the first year, with a structured ramp, including enterprise rollups, and understand how each client’s EMR and PM System environment shapes workflows and results.
  • Growth partnership. Identify and qualify expansion opportunities and hand them to Account Management or Sales with context. Provide usage and outcome insight ahead of renewals, which Account Management leads along with pricing.
  • Collaboration. Advocate for clients across Implementation, Support, Product, Sales and Marketing. Bring the voice of the client to Product, and partner with Marketing on references, case studies and webinars.
  • Ways of working. Use AI-enabled tools to prepare for client calls and analyze performance and handle client data in line with HIPAA and Clearwave’s PHI policy.

What Success Looks Like

Success is measured by adoption and outcome improvement across the book, account health movement, client satisfaction and executive engagement, qualified expansion opportunities, the quality of insight supporting renewals and the accuracy of Salesforce and health score data.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of two (2) years in a Customer Success Manager role, or 5+ years in a related client-facing SaaS role, with a proven record of driving post-sale adoption and measurable client outcomes. Healthcare SaaS experience strongly preferred.
  • Strong business acumen, experience with or demonstrated aptitude for executive-level presentations and analytical comfort turning data into a clear story. Salesforce experience is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills, with poise and tact in high-pressure situations. Self-directed and organized in a remote, team-based environment.
  • Willingness to travel 10% to 25%.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year college or university, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • 5+ years of healthcare experience with strong knowledge of the patient intake and patient access process.
  • Familiarity with EMR and PM System platforms, revenue cycle workflows, and HIPAA. Experience with enterprise or multi-location clients.

Corporate Travel Consultant - Warwick Team

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend three weeks (paid) training. This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM EST Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 8 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences
  • Health benefits including, medical, dental, vision, gender affirming care, and fertility care
  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

Director of Growth (India-Based)

Location:India (Remote)Type:Full-time ContractorReports To:CEO, Vulcury LLC

About Vulcury

Vulcury LLC is a venture studio and holding-company platform building and scaling multiple business lines — including Trustbridge (AI-enabled manufacturing supplier matching) and Calisade (research/investment) — alongside a growing portfolio of spinout ventures. We operate lean, with a small senior leadership team supported by a distributed team of junior specialists working under structured systems and processes.

The Role

We're looking for a Director of Growth to own demand generation end-to-end — the counterpart, in growth, to what our Director of AI/ML Development is to engineering. You'll bring 5-10 years of hands-on experience, set the standard for quality and craft, and manage a cadre of junior marketers already in place, with full ownership of the function and no layer of leadership above you other than Vulcury's President.

This is a senior leadership role, not just an individual contributor position. You will both execute at a high level and manage junior team members executing under your direction, spanning the full demand generation funnel — marketing, sales oversight, and everything in between. You'll support growth needs across our core consultancy, our internal spinout ventures, and potentially client engagements as our services expand.

Compensation

We pay market rate, with potential equity upside for the right candidate.


Requirements

What We're Looking For
  • 5-10 years of marketing and/or sales experience, with demonstrated ability to manage people and not just campaigns or accounts
  • Experience owning both marketing execution and sales pipeline oversight — a true full-funnel operator
  • Experience in B2B strongly preferred
  • Background or genuine fluency in one or more of: supply chain/manufacturing, venture studios/consulting, or finance/hedge funds — through prior work, education, or adjacent experience
  • Proven ability to build and run demand generation operations across multiple channels simultaneously (not a single-channel specialist)
  • Comfortable working with data — segmentation, tracking, attribution, funnel conversion — not just creative execution
  • Strong written communication; capable of producing and reviewing blog and content work directly
  • Able to operate with autonomy in a lean, fast-moving, AI-augmented team structure with minimal traditional middle management

Nice to Have
  • Experience marketing and selling for a holding company, venture studio, or multi-business-line organization
  • Familiarity with CRM/marketing automation tooling and AI-assisted workflows
  • Prior experience managing distributed or international teams

Benefits

What You'll Own
  • Team leadership:Manage and mentor a team of junior marketers — reviewing work, setting priorities, and building their skills toward independent execution
  • Demand generation, top to bottom:Own the full funnel from awareness through pipeline to close, including:
    • Email marketing
    • Social media
    • PR
    • Website/web presence
    • Webinars
    • Blog writing and content strategy
    • Sales oversight — pipeline management, conversion, and close-rate accountability
  • Data & measurement:Own segmentation, tracking, and reporting infrastructure across all channels and the sales funnel to inform strategy and prove ROI
  • Cross-venture support:Adapt growth strategy across different business contexts — from an early-stage venture studio/consultancy model to spinouts in supply chain/manufacturing and potentially high finance/hedge fund contexts
  • Startup growth mindset:Bring a growth orientation suited to early-stage and scaling businesses, not just steady-state brand marketing or account management

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

We're seeking an experienced VIP Corporate Travel Consultant to join our Emergency Customer Care (ECC) team, delivering white-glove, personalized service to C-Suite executives and high-profile clients during after-hours, overnight, weekend, and holiday periods. This role is uniquely designed for a seasoned travel professional who thrives in high-pressure situations and understands that for our VIP clientele, exceptional service never sleeps.

As a VIP Emergency Customer Care Consultant, you will manage urgent and complex domestic and international travel requests, including air, hotel, car, and ground transportation, via Sabre GDS, while maintaining the highest standard of professionalism, discretion, and client satisfaction. You will serve as a trusted advisor and first point of contact when our most valued clients need assistance the most.

Before you begin your role, you will complete a four-week paid training program designed to boost your industry knowledge, train you on contract airfares, and sharpen your Sabre skills, ensuring you are fully equipped to deliver the VIP experience our clients expect around the clock.

**Please note that this is a remote after-hours position that requires working overnights, weekends, and holidays**

This position requires flexible hours and shift availability as determined by business need and client call volume.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver exceptional, white-glove service to C-Suite travelers and their administrative staff during after-hours and emergency situations, ensuring all interactions are handled with the utmost professionalism and discretion.
  • Provide consultative support throughout the booking process, crafting bespoke travel itineraries tailored to the specific needs and elevated expectations of VIP and executive-level clients.
  • Coordinate urgent air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for complex domestic and international travel, often within time-sensitive and high-pressure timelines.
  • Expertly manage rerouting, exchanges, and itinerary changes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans and a seamless experience for the client from start to finish.
  • Proactively gather, retain, and apply client travel preferences and profiles to deliver a consistently personalized and anticipatory level of service.
  • Keep VIP clients informed of all necessary travel documents, visa requirements, and health requirements for international destinations, providing guidance with confidence and accuracy.
  • Proficiently handle ticketing, Phase IVs, and complex exchanges and changes involving both domestic and international fares.
  • Execute all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, PNR documentation and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and quality control, maintaining the highest degree of accuracy throughout.
  • Stay fully informed of airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements, applying this knowledge accurately and efficiently to all travel arrangements.
  • Demonstrate creative thinking and decisive problem-solving skills to provide optimal travel solutions in fast-paced, high-stakes situations.
  • Maintain ongoing communication with team members, Travel Managers, and Team Leaders through provided channels to ensure a united, consistent, and professional approach to VIP account management.
  • Complete all reservations accurately and in a timely manner, including post-trip follow-up and support where applicable.
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 3+ years of recent experience as a VIP or Executive Travel Agent, with a demonstrated ability to serve C-level executives and high-profile clients with discretion and professionalism.
  • 4+ years of recent experience in corporate travel management, with a thorough understanding of the unique needs and challenges of business travelers, particularly in emergency and after-hours scenarios.
  • Expert in managing complex, urgent, and time-sensitive travel requests with precision, including the ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to ensure seamless VIP travel experiences.
  • In-depth familiarity with Sabre GDS for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance, along with proficiency in ticketing procedures, scripting, and handling complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both domestic and international travel.
  • Comfortable and proficient using Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Teams), travel booking tools (Concur, Deem), and various communication tools, with a strong technical aptitude and the ability to adapt to new technologies quickly.
  • Skilled in building long-term relationships with elite clientele by proactively gathering and retaining travel preferences, handling bespoke requests with discretion, and maintaining a comprehensive understanding of global geography and international destinations.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings, with strong attention to detail even in fast-paced, high-pressure situations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a polished, professional, and empathetic demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • A natural inclination to respond promptly to emergency travel requests, with the ability to handle high-stress situations, make quick and effective decisions, and provide expert guidance while consistently upholding the VIP standard of service.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

About Flight Centre Travel Group

Flight Centre Travel Group is one of the world’s largest travel companies with over 12,000 employees globally - who we call ‘Flighties’. With over thirty brands under our family tree and headquarters in more than twenty countries, our roles are diverse and our opportunities are endless. When, we say we’re a great place to work, we have the proof to back it up. Over the past 12 years we’ve been voted a ‘Great Place to Work’ including one of the Best Workplaces for Wellbeing and Best Workplaces for Women. Together, we live and breathe our number one philosophy, our people, and turn up each day driven by our purpose to open up the world for those who want to see. Put simply, we’re a bunch of travel lovers looking for more travel lovers to join our family.

About the role

WhereTo is looking for a Product Enablement Specialist to help run the function that becomes the go-to point of contact for product questions across our business. WhereTo is a nimble, startup-minded team within Flight Centre Travel Group focused on building the next-generation business travel platform that serves two of Flight Centre's main business travel brands, Corporate Traveller and FCM.

As Product Enablement Specialist, you'll own the day-to-day execution of the function: triaging incoming questions and stakeholder feedback, consolidating roadmap information, supporting go-to-market communication for new releases, drafting release notes and product-win comms, and documenting what's shipped, working closely with and reporting to the Product Enablement Lead, who sets the standards and handles anything complex or sensitive. You'll be a key point of contact for Sales, Account Management, Customer Support, and Brand stakeholders when they need clear, accurate answers about what we're building.

If you're a sharp, clear communicator who enjoys being the person who always has the answer, or knows exactly who does, we'd love to hear from you.

About you

Experience:

  • 2+ years in a role centered on internal communications, product operations, technical/solutions support, or a similar cross-functional capacity.
  • Experience translating technical or product detail for non-technical audiences.

Skills:

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, this is the core of the role.
  • Strong organizational skills and comfort maintaining a single source of truth across multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to synthesize complex product information into clear, concise updates for varied audiences.
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Account Management.
  • Proficient with roadmap and release management tooling (Product Board and JIRA being our current tools of choice) and internal comms platforms (e.g., Workvivo).

Industry Knowledge:

  • General understanding of the business travel industry and WhereTo's product portfolio across both brands.
  • Comfort learning quickly across a broad product surface, since this role touches the full breadth of what WhereTo builds rather than one specific product line.

Adaptability:

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment, particularly while helping stand up a brand-new function.

What's in it for you

  • Exclusive Travel Discounts: As part of Flight Centre Travel Group, you gain access to exclusive industry rates and discounts through our in-house travel team.
  • Career Development: With Flight Centre Travel Group’s global presence, spanning 30+ brands in over 20 countries, you’ll have clear career pathways and the resources you need to achieve your professional goals, including training and support.
  • Vibrant Culture & industry-renowned social events: Experience our fun, industry-renowned culture with exciting social events such as monthly awards nights, global conferences, end-of-financial-year balls, and more.
  • Active Hour: Prioritise your well-being with an hour dedicated each week to focus on your fitness or personal wellness.
  • Comprehensive Health Cash Plan: Get reimbursed for a variety of medical services, including dental, optical, and chiropractic care, with our bronze-level health cash plan.
  • Health & Wellbeing Challenges: Stay engaged with monthly health and wellbeing challenges designed to keep you motivated and healthy.
  • Financial Wellbeing Support: Access expert financial services, including mortgage advice, regulated financial guidance, and money coaching to help you manage your finances.
  • And Much More: Enjoy a range of additional benefits, including company-matched charitable donations, an excellent pension scheme, share options, an electric vehicle scheme, and a variety of salary sacrifice benefits.

This is a remote position.

Director of Growth (US-Based, Part-Time)

Location:United States (Remote)Type:Part-Time Contractor (target ~50% time; flexible for the right candidate)Reports To:CEO, Vulcury LLC

About Vulcury

Vulcury LLC is a venture studio and holding-company platform building and scaling multiple business lines — including Trustbridge (AI-enabled manufacturing supplier matching) and Calisade (research/investment) — alongside a growing portfolio of spinout ventures. We operate lean, with a small senior leadership team supported by a distributed team of junior specialists working under structured systems and processes.

The Role

We're looking for a Director of Growth to own demand generation end-to-end. This role is structured as part-time (targeting roughly half-time) as a matter of capital discipline at our stage — but we're open to a different arrangement for the right person. What matters most is not the hours on a calendar, but that our India-based marketing team has a consistent, engaged source of direction and does not go without leadership day to day.

You'll bring 5-10 years of hands-on experience, set the standard for quality and craft, and manage a cadre of junior marketers already in place, with full ownership of the function and no layer of leadership above you other than Vulcury's President.

This is a senior leadership role, not just an individual contributor position. You will both execute at a high level and manage junior team members executing under your direction, spanning the full demand generation funnel — marketing, sales oversight, and everything in between. You'll support growth needs across our core consultancy, our internal spinout ventures, and potentially client engagements as our services expand.

Schedule note:Because our junior marketing team is based in India, this role requires regular, dependable overlap with India business hours — not occasional, but a standing part of the job. In practice, this means being comfortable logging on in the early morning or staying online into the late evening (US time) on a recurring basis to hold live check-ins, reviews, and coaching sessions with the team. The India team's need for consistent direction is the fixed point of this role; the exact hours structure around it can flex.

Compensation

We pay market rate, prorated to the agreed time commitment, with potential equity upside for the right candidate.


Requirements

What We're Looking For
  • 5-10 years of marketing and/or sales experience, with demonstrated ability to manage people and not just campaigns or accounts
  • Experience owning both marketing execution and sales pipeline oversight — a true full-funnel operator
  • Experience in B2B strongly preferred
  • Background or genuine fluency in one or more of: supply chain/manufacturing, venture studios/consulting, or finance/hedge funds — through prior work, education, or adjacent experience
  • Proven ability to build and run demand generation operations across multiple channels simultaneously (not a single-channel specialist)
  • Comfortable working with data — segmentation, tracking, attribution, funnel conversion — not just creative execution
  • Strong written communication; capable of producing and reviewing blog and content work directly
  • Able to operate with autonomy in a lean, fast-moving, AI-augmented team structure with minimal traditional middle management
  • Willing and able to provide consistent, ongoing direction to a team on India business hours— comfortable anchoring recurring check-ins to early mornings or late evenings (US time)

Nice to Have
  • Experience marketing and selling for a holding company, venture studio, or multi-business-line organization
  • Prior experience managing distributed or international teams, particularly across US-India time zones
  • Familiarity with CRM/marketing automation tooling and AI-assisted workflows

Benefits

What You'll Own
  • Team leadership:Manage and mentor a team of junior marketers based in India — reviewing work, setting priorities, and building their skills toward independent execution
  • Demand generation, top to bottom:Own the full funnel from awareness through pipeline to close, including:
    • Email marketing
    • Social media
    • PR
    • Website/web presence
    • Webinars
    • Blog writing and content strategy
    • Sales oversight — pipeline management, conversion, and close-rate accountability
  • Data & measurement:Own segmentation, tracking, and reporting infrastructure across all channels and the sales funnel to inform strategy and prove ROI
  • Cross-venture support:Adapt growth strategy across different business contexts — from an early-stage venture studio/consultancy model to spinouts in supply chain/manufacturing and potentially high finance/hedge fund contexts
  • Startup growth mindset:Bring a growth orientation suited to early-stage and scaling businesses, not just steady-state brand marketing or account management

In this pivotal role, you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, prioritize workflows, and bring strategic visions to life through agile methodologies. If you're passionate about shaping impactful products and making a difference, we want to hear from you!

WHAT WE CAN OFFER YOU:

  • Estimated Salary: Product Owner: $100,000 - $118,000 plus annual bonus opportunity
  • 401(k) plan with a 2% company contribution and 6% company match.
  • Work-life balance with vacation, personal time and paid holidays. See our benefits and perks page for details.
  • Applicants for this position must not now, nor at any point in the future, require sponsorship for employment.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Drive Product Solutions: Lead cross-functional teams and Agile Release Train resources to deliver high-value product solutions aligned with strategic visions, ensuring consistent customer value delivery.

  • Backlog Prioritization: Manage and refine product backlogs by balancing business value, stakeholder input, and strategic priorities to achieve impactful outcomes.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with ART leadership, business owners, subject matter experts, and other Product Owners to define and refine features, ensuring clear acceptance criteria and seamless communication across teams.

  • Agile Leadership: Act as a Product Owner for an Agile Release Train car, participating in planning, demos, retrospectives, and ceremonies to enhance product quality and team velocity.

  • Outcome Monitoring: Oversee business outcomes by tracking progress, adjusting priorities, and resolving delivery challenges while ensuring seamless transitions to operations, including training and communication.

  • Risk Mitigation: Identify and address risks in partnership with system delivery teams, escalating and resolving issues to keep projects on track while aligning with business goals.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Professional Experience: 3+ years in a business role or as a Product Owner/Product Manager, with a track record of leading product development, prioritizing work, and delivering outcomes aligned to business strategy;4+ years as an expert contributor on a systems team with deep knowledge of internal/external-facing UI technology and related backend systems that support insurance activities (e.g., enrollment, premium payment, and enrollee/member data management).

  • Agile Product Ownership Expertise: Ability to serve as a Product Owner for one or more Agile Release Train cars, with a conceptual understanding of the SAFe framework and its roles, processes, and collaboration methods.

  • Industry and Technical Knowledge: Familiarity with the insurance industry, operational business processes, and a broad understanding of technology domains, including cloud, client-server, SaaS, and Enterprise Architecture.

  • Leadership and Communication Skills: Strong leadership, collaboration, and negotiation abilities to build relationships with stakeholders, guide teams, and resolve conflicts effectively.

  • Analytical and Organizational Proficiency: Excellent time management, prioritization, and data-driven decision-making skills, coupled with the ability to independently manage complex, multi-year initiatives.

PREFERRED:

  • Proven ability to analyze and map complex data flows across systems, with a focus on external/internal facing User Interface (UI) and relationships to backend systems.

  • Strong understanding of Group Insurance concepts around member enrollment life cycles, member management, premium and billing.

We value diverse experience, skills, and passion for innovation. If your experience aligns with the listed requirements, please apply!

If you have questions about your application or thehiring process, email our Talent Acquisition area . Please allow at least one week from time of applying if you are checking on the status.

Mutual of Omaha only accepts applications frommutualofomaha.com/careers. Legitimate communications will come from '@mutualofomaha.com.' We never request sensitive information or extend job offers without conducting interviews. For more details, check ourHiring FAQs. Stay alert for scams and apply securely!
