raw.title: Director of Agricultural Policy
raw.excerpt: About SparkSpark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolved climate challenges.
raw.description:
About Spark

Spark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolved climate challenges. Our goal is to enable a safer climate by filling targeted gaps in current climate actions. We look around the corner at the key blind spots that pose big climate risks or offer big climate opportunities, like major sources of unabated emissions. Then we work to speed up the development of the fields needed to address those challenges.
We are a team of scientists, policy experts, innovators, and systems thinkers working to build today’s foundations for the comprehensive climate solutions we will need tomorrow. Rather than betting on individual pathways or innovations, we work to grow a field as a whole so that the most effective science and solutions can be surfaced and scaled. We use a large suite of field-building tools to support new research, markets, policies, and talent development, through both in-house initiatives and building broader coalitions. We are currently focused on super pollutants from agriculture (specifically methane and nitrous oxide), warming-induced greenhouse gas emissions, and methane removal.
Spark’s impact is made possible by a community of generous and pioneering individuals, foundations, and organizations that share our vision for a safer climate future.

Position Summary

Spark Climate Solutions seeks an experienced agricultural policy leader with experience working across party lines to drive U.S. policy strategy and execution for Spark's agriculture program areas: Livestock Enteric Methane Mitigation and Agricultural Nitrogen Transformation. The policy remit spans a range of agricultural issues with potential climate implications, including policies and approaches that support agricultural innovation, research, and development.
At Spark, policy plays a critical role in accelerating the fields we work in. For example, to advance public research funding for methane removal, Spark supported the development and introduction of the bipartisan Methane Removal Research and Innovation Act (MRRIA) in the House, which would establish the first dedicated federal methane removal research program at DOE; the Livestock Enteric Program helped advance the Innovative Feed Act, now included in the Senate Agriculture Committee's Farm Bill draft, which would establish a new, faster regulatory pathway for methane-reducing feed additives.
This role combines policy strategy and original policy development (drafting proposals, legislative language, and analytical memos) with active coalition and stakeholder engagement across federal agencies, Congress, trade associations, and producer groups. Specifically, this role will focus on:
  1. Translation of the programs’ science and field needs into a viable and actionable long-term policy strategy for current and future Congresses and administrations.
  2. U.S. federal policy development for approaches that include methane and nitrous oxide mitigation from crop and livestock systems, including research, development, demonstration, deployment, and de-risking proposals.
  3. Coalition and stakeholder engagement with trade associations, producer groups, federal agencies, and Congressional offices.
This role reports to the Spark's Nitrogen Program Director and will work closely with the Livestock Enteric Methane Mitigation Program Director.

Who We’re Looking For

  • A seasoned agricultural policy professional with deep federal experience who knows how the farm bill, appropriations cycles, and USDA conservation programs (EQIP, CSP, RCPP) work and has experience influencing them.
  • Someone with strong existing bipartisan relationships in agricultural policy circles: Hill staff, USDA, EPA, trade associations, producer groups, and ag policy NGOs.
  • A capable writer who can move fluidly between technical policy memos, legislative language, congressional briefings, and concise stakeholder-facing materials.
  • A strategic thinker who can work backward from a multi-year program goal and design the policy pathway, including which proposals to develop, when, and with whom.
  • Someone with the judgment to know when Spark should lead, when it should support a coalition, and when it should sit out.
  • Someone comfortable working across two program areas with overlapping but distinct stakeholder ecosystems and political dynamics.
  • Someone who can balance the creativity and practicality needed to break through otherwise intractable policy challenges.
  • A collaborative operator who can take loose direction from Program Directors and a peer policy lead and turn it into a coherent work plan.
  • Someone who cares about climate change, is energized by the specific problem of agricultural super pollutants, and is prepared to lead on both incremental proposals and broader visions that would help the U.S. best leverage policy to tackle the two largest sources of greenhouse gas emissions from agriculture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the U.S. federal policy strategy for Spark’s agricultural programs, in support of the Enteric and Nitrogen Program strategies.
  • Develop (a) multi-year policy plan(s) that support both programs’ priorities, accounting for the U.S. agricultural policy opportunity landscape and refreshing it as the political environment evolves.
  • Draft policy proposals, legislative language, and supporting analytical memos for federal RD&D and deployment policy, including marker legislation (e.g., CATTLE Act for enteric) and proposals targeting USDA conservation, risk management, and clean fuels programs (EQIP, CSP, RCPP, 45Z, SAFs) for nitrogen.
  • Engage directly with Congressional offices, USDA, EPA, and other federal agencies on annual appropriations authorizing legislation, and rulemaking.
  • Lead trade-association alignment work for the Nitrogen program and support coalition engagement for the Enteric program, including establishing partnerships with new members.
  • Advise on state-level engagement where high-leverage.
  • Advise on international policy engagement opportunities as relevant.
  • Represent Spark in policy convenings, congressional briefings, and partner forums.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree with 10+ years of professional experience in agricultural policy, federal government, or related fields; or Master's degree (e.g., MPP, MPA, JD) with 8+ years of experience.
  • Demonstrated track record developing and advancing federal agricultural policy, with examples of policy proposals, legislation, or rulemaking you helped shape.
  • Strong existing network in agricultural policy: Hill, USDA/EPA, trade associations, producer groups, and ag policy NGOs.
  • Excellent writing skills, including the ability to draft legislative language, technical policy memos, and stakeholder-facing materials with limited revision.
  • Ability to translate scientific and technical content into policy proposals that are credible to both technical and political audiences.
  • Sound strategic judgment about when, where, and how to engage; comfortable making and defending recommendations.
  • Collaborative working style; able to operate across program teams with different priorities, voices, and stakeholder bases.

Nice to Have:

  • Direct experience with one or both: livestock methane policy, nitrogen/nutrient management policy.
  • Experience working at the intersection of agriculture and climate.
  • Familiarity with EU and other international ag/climate policy regimes.
  • Prior experience in a small, fast-moving non-profit or startup environment.

Why Join Us

Spark Climate Solutions is a nimble, impact-focused nonprofit driving urgent progress on underinvested climate solutions. You’ll join a team of scientists, strategists, and systems thinkers working to pull forward the timeline for high-impact climate solutions. This role offers the chance to make a material difference on some of the world’s toughest climate challenges.

Eligibility

Open to candidates authorized to work in the United States.

Location

As with all positions at Spark Climate Solutions, this will be 100% remote. For this position, the employee must be located in the Washington DC area or within a reasonable distance to allow for frequent in-person travel to DC.

Compensation

  • 170k-185k/year
  • Competitive benefits package including 90% health coverage and 80% coverage for dependents, 401k matching, generous PTO, sick time, and an end-of-year closure, parental leave, annual national park pass, and more.

6-Month Goals

  • Build a working U.S. agricultural policy opportunity landscape covering both enteric methane and agricultural nitrogen, in coordination with the respective program leads.
  • Establish active relationships with priority Congressional offices, USDA conservation and clean fuels programs, and key trade associations across both program areas.
  • Drive forward at least one priority federal policy proposal per program.
  • Contribute to FY28 appropriations strategy.
  • Develop and align the multi-year policy roadmaps for both programs and integrate them into Spark's broader policy function plan.
  • Represent Spark in external policy convenings or briefings.

You’ll work closely with internal marketing leaders, regional teams and strategic technology partners such as Microsoft, AWS and Google.   • Demonstrated ability to personally drive campaigns end-to-end, rather than solely coordinating activities or executing centrally developed programs.
  • Strong strategic marketing capabilities, including positioning, messaging, content strategy and translating complex propositions into compelling campaigns.
  • Ability to operate as both an orchestrator and a doer, comfortable influencing senior stakeholders while remaining hands-on.
  • Strong practical understanding of AI and how it can systematically improve marketing workflows, decision-making, measurement and efficiency, beyond basic content generation.
  • Comfortable working virtually across regional and global teams and multiple time zones.

Our client is a fast-growing multinational group spanning manufacturing, trading, and FMCG, expanding into new markets and partnerships. They are seeking an experienced Global Tax Lead to head corporate tax for one or more key business units.

  • Senior role within the group's central corporate tax function, working closely with regional tax teams.
  • Provides strategic tax guidance and oversight, aligned with group governance and objectives.
  • Drives tax-efficient cross-border structuring and stays ahead of regulatory and geopolitical change.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Tax Leadership

  • Set and execute tax strategy for the business unit, aligned with group policy and governance.
  • Advise local tax teams on commercial decisions and expansion initiatives.
  • Optimise effective tax rate through cross-border structuring and trade flows.
  • Monitor regulatory and geopolitical developments and advise the business proactively.

Tax Compliance and Risk Management

  • Ensure accurate, timely tax filings across the business unit.
  • Guide local teams on provisioning, reporting, and compliance.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate tax risk with strong internal controls.

Tax Planning and Advisory

  • Advise on cross-border transactions, operating structures, and market entry.
  • Partner with commercial, finance, and legal teams on expansions, partnerships, and restructuring.
  • Own tax audits and manage relationships with advisors and tax authorities.

Operational Excellence

  • Embed best-practice tax governance across the business unit.
  • Drive process and system improvements for efficiency and transparency.
  • Support knowledge-sharing between corporate and regional teams.

Team Leadership and Development

  • Lead and mentor business unit tax teams on complex matters.
  • Strengthen alignment between corporate and regional tax functions.

What We're Looking For

  • Degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.
  • 15+ years of progressive international tax experience, in-house or with a top advisory firm.
  • Strong expertise in international tax, cross-border structuring, and transfer pricing, with a track record of optimising effective tax rates.
  • Background in fast-growing manufacturing, trading, or FMCG businesses across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Strong commercial and analytical capability in complex tax environments.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and lead regional tax teams.
  • Willing to travel internationally as required.

Must-Haves

  • Strong international tax and transfer pricing expertise, including HQ/trading hub models, BEPS, ETR management, and global tax planning.
  • Exposure to multinational or globally distributed business structures, ideally trading, manufacturing, or cross-border organisations.
  • Hands-on operator, comfortable as an individual contributor managing detailed tax matters directly.
  • Solid technical foundation, ideally Big 4-trained, with strong knowledge of direct and indirect tax.

Track Record That Matters

  • Sizable, demonstrable wins in lowering effective tax rates through tax structuring.
  • Experience managing transfer pricing disputes or controversies with tax authorities.
  • Ready to speak to specific, quantifiable outcomes.

If you're a senior international tax leader ready for your next strategic challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

raw.description:
The Vice President of Business Development is a key revenue-driving executive responsible for defining and leading enterprise-level growth strategy across the M3 Wake Research's network. Reporting to the Chief Executive Officer, this leader oversees new business acquisition, expansion of existing CRO and sponsor partnerships, and optimization of study volume across all sites. The role partners closely with Clinical Operations, Clinical Affairs, Marketing, Regulatory, Quality, Finance, and HR to ensure integrated planning and flawless execution. This position will shape market positioning, build a scalable and high-performing BD organization, and ensure the company is consistently recognized as a preferred site network partner in the clinical research industry.

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive, data-driven sales strategies in alignment with the CEO to drive study awards and revenue growth.
  • Penetrate high-value pharmaceutical, biotech, and CRO accounts to establish long-term, strategic partnerships that increase study volume and preferred-partner positioning.
  • Expand business with existing clients by identifying growth opportunities, leading account strategy, and enhancing account performance.
  • Conduct ongoing market and competitive analysis to identify emerging opportunities and inform strategic direction.
  • Represent the organization at conferences, sponsor summits, and industry events to elevate visibility and expand key relationships.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop campaigns that highlight PI expertise, patient access, site capabilities, and network strengths.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing Business Development team with clear expectations, KPIs, and accountability structures.
  • Recruit top business development talent and oversee territory and account allocation aligned with organizational priorities.
  • Conduct regular 1:1s, mid-year and annual performance reviews, and ongoing assessments to ensure team success.
  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline metrics, and activity reporting through the CRM.
  • Present performance insights and strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Manage special initiatives or strategic projects as assigned by the CEO.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; BA/BS in Business, Marketing, or Life Sciences preferred.
  • MBA highly desirable.
  • 7–10+ years of progressive sales experience within a clinical research site network or comparable research environment.
  • Demonstrated success securing multi-site study opportunities with pharmaceutical sponsors, CROs, and biotech organizations.
  • Established executive-level relationships across CRO and sponsor communities.
  • Deep understanding of clinical research operations, feasibility, timelines, and site dynamics.
  • Proven ability to build, scale, and lead high-performing BD teams.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.
  • Proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce.com preferred).
  • Ability to work autonomously and thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strategic mindset with analytical and data-driven decision-making capability.
  • Exceptional relationship management and consultative selling skills.
  • High accountability and ownership of targets.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and partnership-building abilities.
  • Ability to juggle competing priorities and adapt rapidly to change.
  • Commitment to excellence, continuous improvement, and operational rigor.

About M3:

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Our success is anchored in our trusted digital platforms that engage physician communities globally, facilitating impactful medical education, precise job placement, and insightful market research. M3 USA prides itself on a dynamic and innovative work environment where every team member contributes to global health advancements.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Benefits:

A career opportunity with M3 Wake Research offers competitive wages, and benefits such as:

  • 401(k), 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Disability insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account
  • Health insurance
  • Life insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

*M3 reserves the right to change this job description to meet the business needs of the organization

M3 Wake Research, an M3USA Company, is an integrated network of premier investigational sites meeting the clinical research needs of global biopharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical device, pharmaceutical and clinical research organizations (CROs). With close to 30 owned and managed research sites across the country, M3 Wake Research is one of the largest independent, multi-site clinical research companies in the US. M3 Wake Research continues to grow through acquisitions and uncompromising commitment to careful planning and execution in accordance with regulatory compliance.

Conducting studies since 1984, M3 Wake Research owns a proprietary patient database of potential clinical trial participants across the US. As of today, our board-certified physicians have completed more than 7,000+ successful clinical trials, while consistently exceeding sponsor expectations for integrity, timeliness, subject enrollment, human protection, and expeditious delivery of accurate evaluable data.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Vice President of Business Development at Wake Research, an M3 company. This is a remote position with up to 50% domestic-travel.

raw.excerpt: About OpenMinedOpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared.
raw.description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own how OpenMined plans, tracks, and ships its most ambitious work. You'll work most closely with Ronnie Falcon, Chief Product Officer, and you'll be the person accountable for timelines, dependencies, and delivery across our product, engineering, research, and partnerships teams.

OpenMined runs several high-stakes efforts at once. ScreamingFace is an open-source toolkit for composing multiple LLMs into systems that beat any single frontier model, with a public leaderboard and a research fellowship. AI Oversight builds privacy-preserving infrastructure that lets AI labs, auditors, and safety institutes run evaluations without exposing models or data, with pilots alongside frontier labs. These efforts span multiple teams, tools, and funders, and they move fast under real research uncertainty.

Our product leads decide what to build, and our tech leads decide how it's built. You'll own when and in what order it gets delivered. That means turning goals into milestones with real dates, keeping roadmaps current rather than rewriting them once a year, and making our tools a source of truth people trust. It also means telling leadership early when a date is about to slip and what the options are.

This is a technical role. You'll work daily with engineers and researchers on distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, and privacy-enhancing technologies. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the work well enough to break it down, spot risk, and challenge an estimate.

We're an AI-native team. Our engineers ship with AI coding agents, our main codebase releases several times a week, and our tools and habits keep evolving as AI does. We're looking for a seasoned technical program manager who has built and run project management practices for teams like this. You'll bring years of hands-on experience, use AI to make planning, tracking, and reporting faster and lighter, and help OpenMined become a team that is excellent at project management, not one that depends on a single person to do it.

This is an independent contractor engagement, roughly a full-time commitment, with an initial 12-month term we expect to renew. You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time within about one hour of ET).

Responsibilities

  • Own delivery end to end for OpenMined's flagship initiatives (ScreamingFace and AI Oversight), from quarterly goals to milestones, dependencies, and release dates.
  • Design, run, and keep improving our project management practice for an AI-native team: planning, tracking, status reporting, and retros built around how engineers work with AI agents today, and updated as those tools change.
  • Build AI into how we manage projects: use and build AI agents and automations that draft status updates, summarize Linear, GitHub, and meeting activity, flag risks and stale work, and keep plans current with little manual upkeep.
  • Make the whole team better at project management: set standards and templates, coach product and engineering leads, and grow project management skills across the team, laying the groundwork for future project management hires.
  • Turn quarterly OKRs into dated, sequenced plans with product and engineering leads, and keep them current as research results and priorities shift.
  • Run a living product roadmap that is reviewed on a regular cadence and can feed grant proposals and funder reports without a last-minute rewrite.
  • Be the single accountable owner for cross-team dependencies when one initiative spans several boards, teams, or external partners, and chase down blockers yourself before they cause a slip.
  • Own our project management tooling (Linear for engineering, Asana for cross-functional work): set conventions, cut noise, and make sure status in the tools matches reality.
  • Connect code to plans: make sure work in GitHub links to Linear issues across all active repos, and keep PR review, release status, and repo ownership visible.
  • Track and report progress on milestones, cycle time, and OKR key results to leadership, and flag slipping dates early with clear trade-off options.
  • Coordinate external deliverables such as partner pilots, program launches (e.g., our research fellowship), and grant milestones, so commitments to partners and funders are met.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of technical project or program management, delivering complex software with product and engineering teams. Transferable experience, such as a software engineering background, will also be considered.
  • Built or rebuilt a project management practice: set up planning cadences, tooling, and standards that a team kept using, earned buy-in through credibility rather than heavy process, and raised others' project management skills.
  • Has shaped project management for AI-native teams: worked with engineers who build with AI coding agents, and changed processes as those workflows evolved.
  • Uses AI in their own project management work every day: has built or set up AI agents, automations, or workflows for status reporting, risk detection, planning, or tracker hygiene, and can show concrete results.
  • Delivered under continuous shipping and technical uncertainty: R&D, ML/AI, infrastructure, or developer platforms with frequent releases and changing plans.
  • Technical foundation: a computer science or other technical degree, or 3+ years working as a software engineer. Comfortable reading code, PRs, and architecture docs.
  • Deep, hands-on use of engineering trackers such as Linear, Jira, and GitHub. You've designed a team's workflow, not only used one.
  • Clear, concise communication, written and spoken: you can explain status, risk, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and funders.

Preferred

  • Experience working on a fully remote, distributed team.
  • Has mentored or managed other project or program managers, or helped hire them.
  • Experience with LLMs, AI evaluation, AI safety, or privacy-enhancing technologies.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or research lab where you built the delivery process from scratch.
  • Experience managing grant-funded or partner-funded deliverables, such as reporting milestones to funders.
  • Experience coordinating with external partners on pilots or integrations (e.g., AI labs, research institutions, government).
  • Open-source project experience, as a contributor or as a project or release manager.

Compensation

  • Contract fee: $127,000 - $159,000 USD annualized, invoiced monthly.
  • Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location.

Benefits

  • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, focused on social impact rather than profit, offering the chance to make a meaningful difference in the world.
  • Open Source Contribution: Make a real impact by contributing to an Open Source project that benefits a broad community.
  • Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity.
  • Flexible Work Hours: Enjoy the autonomy to structure your work hours around what best fits your life and productivity.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within the location requirements for this role.

NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is seeking a Senior ASIC Compose Verification Infrastructure and Tools Engineer to advance the systems that qualify, integrate, and deliver complex ASIC IP across multiple products. This role is ideal for an RTL compose or pre-silicon verification engineer who has developed a strong interest in infrastructure, automation, CI, metrics, and efficiency tooling. Our high-speed IO infrastructure team develops the flows that keep large-scale ASIC development moving: integration automation, pre-submit qualification, build and verification infrastructure, operational metrics, and debug workflows. You will work across build, verification, firmware, methodology, and infrastructure teams to make sophisticated engineering systems faster, more reliable, and easier to reason about. You’ll also have access to innovative AI efficiency tools, and we’re looking for someone excited to help us apply them effectively.

What You’ll Be Doing:

  • Apply practical AI workflows where they build leverage, including debug assistance, run triage, summarization, documentation, and workflow automation.

  • Build and improve high-speed IO integration, build, simulation, and pre-submit qualification flows for large ASIC IP development.

  • Improve CI reliability, turnaround time, debuggability, and scalability across distributed compute environments.

  • Root-cause complex failures across development, verification, build systems, tools, infrastructure, and compute environments.

  • Turn recurring integration or qualification difficulties into durable automation and process improvements.

  • Define, publish, and actively use metrics for integration latency, flow health, failure trends, and engineering efficiency.

  • Bring metrics into engineering discussions to guide priorities, forecast risk, and optimize the systems we operate.

  • Collaborate with ASIC designers, verification engineers, firmware engineers, methodology teams, and infrastructure partners.

  • Dive into unfamiliar technical areas, understand how the system works end to end, and drive ambiguous problems to closure.

What We Need To See:

  • BS or MS in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of relevant industry experience.

  • Strong understanding of ASIC development workflows, including builds, simulation, regressions, debug, integration, and qualification.

  • Experience with verification methodology such as UVM or similar.

  • Strong working knowledge of Verilog/SystemVerilog, including RTL development or pre-silicon verification/debug experience.

  • Exposure to industry simulation and debug tools such as VCS, Verdi, Xcelium, or similar.

  • Strong programming skills in Python, Perl, or another scripting/systems programming language.

  • Experience with SystemVerilog and object-oriented verification environments.

  • Strong root-cause analysis skills, especially for intermittent or hard-to-isolate infrastructure failures.

  • Self-directed execution: ability to take a loosely defined technical problem, investigate across domains, and deliver a working solution.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:

  • Established passion for infrastructure, automation, and driving efficiency gains outside your core RTL or DV tasks.

  • Strong curiosity about how complex systems operate and a track record of diving across build, verification, tooling, and infrastructure boundaries to solve problems.

  • Practical experience applying AI tools to engineering workflows, including debug automation, summarization, or tool-assisted development.

  • Strong engineering habits centered on clear data: defining useful signals, using them in technical conversations, and optimizing systems against them.

  • Experience providing ASIC IP for several products, projects, or SoCs simultaneously.

With a passion for life

Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.

Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.

Job Overview

The Senior Quality Systems Engineer independently provides hands-on subject matter expertise to support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the Getinge Quality Management System (GetQMS). This role leads the ongoing management and enhancement of the GetKPI process and GetQMS platform to support consistent execution of global quality processes and inspection readiness.

The position coordinates change activities associated with platform and process enhancements. It also partners with IT, Quality process caretakers, and other subject matter experts to improve reporting, automation, and QMS processes.This role supports continuous improvement initiatives across GetQMS, including opportunities to simplify processes, improve reporting, and introduce appropriate automation.

The position is fully remote and the prefered candidate will be in the Eastern Time Zone.

Key Responsibilities

GetKPI Business Process Ownership

  • Serve as the business process owner for GetKPI, ensuring effective operation and continuous improvement of the global KPI process
  • Facilitate implementation of approved changes across GetKPI procedures, the GetKPI Web Application, Power BI, and associated reporting
  • Partner with Quality Process Caretakers and other stakeholders to support consistent interpretation and application of KPI requirements
  • Lead business requirements, change controls, testing, implementation, and communication activities associated with GetKPI enhancements
  • Support GetKPI lifecycle activities, including new KPIs, threshold and methodology changes, scope updates, and retirement of KPIs
  • Extract, organize, and analyze GetKPI data to support Quality forums, management reviews, and other business needs requiring KPI information
  • Develop and maintain GetKPI training material and support delivery of training to promote consistent understanding and effective use of the GetKPI process and system

GetQMS Site Business Process Ownership

  • Serve as the Quality business owner for the GetQMS SharePoint platform, with responsibility for content organization, maintenance, and continuous improvement
  • Manage and enhance GetQMS capabilities, including the GetQMS News page, QMS content, and dashboards
  • Partner with IT and appropriate stakeholders to maintain effective site structure, navigation, content organization, and user access
  • Collaborate with IT to scope, test, and implement platform enhancements and new functionality
  • Identify opportunities to improve how QMS information is communicated, accessed, and used across the organization
  • Develop and maintain GetQMS platform training material and support delivery of training to promote consistent understanding and effective use of the platform
  • Support the authoring, revision, and ongoing maintenance of QMS documents to ensure content remains current, effective, and aligned with GetQMS requirements

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Quality, Life Sciences, Information Systems, or a related field. ASQ, Six sigma or other applicable certifications are a plus.
  • A minimum of 5 years’ experience working within a regulated Quality Management System, preferably within the medical device or life sciences industry
  • Working knowledge of quality metrics, KPI governance, trending, and performance monitoring
  • Experience with SharePoint from a business ownership, content management, or governance perspective
  • Experience partnering with IT or technical teams to implement system, reporting, or workflow enhancements
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI
  • Experience supporting system or process changes through requirements definition, testing, implementation, and change control

The base salary for the position is a minimum of $97,000 and a maximum of $125,000 plus 10% Annual Bonus

With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. About tabbyTabby is on a mission to give people power over their money. For too long, financial systems have worked for the institutions that built them, not the people using them. Runaway interest, fine print and limited access have left many behind, feeling shut out of a system that wasn't setting them up for success.

We're building a different kind of system—in a complete money app to send, spend and save. One that's clear, flexible and puts people and businesses in control. Founded in 2019, we serve customers and businesses across Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates and Kuwait. Millions of customers and 65,000 global brands, government services and small businesses rely on us today.

What began as a better way to pay at checkout has grown into a financial system working the way it should have all along.


About the Role

As a Risk Analyst at Tabby, you will play a key role in analysing risk performance and contributing to the risk strategy across our products. You will work with large datasets to identify trends, monitor portfolio performance, and support data-driven decisions that balance growth with risk discipline. This role is highly cross-functional, requiring close collaboration with data, product and engineering teams to ensure healthy portfolio performance.

What You’ll Do

  • Analyse portfolio performance, customer behavior, and key risk indicators across products and segments.
  • Utilize big data analytics to identify risk patterns and insights. Develop reports and dashboards to monitor risk metrics and performance and present insights to leadership
  • Optimize risk strategies and policies to support sustainable growth
  • Contribute to the design and rollout of new products and policies
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support launches in new markets and verticals
  • Continuously seek to improve risk management processes and strategies through innovation and adopting best practices.

What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 2–4 years of experience in risk management, fraud analytics, or a related data-driven role preferably in the Fintech sector or related financial services.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with SQL, Python or similar tools
  • Understanding of consumer lending, digital wallets, transfers and fintech risk models
  • Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced, high-growth environment
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and concisely.

Job Benefits

Locations
We hire candidates based within four hours of Dubai time, with remote work available in eligible locations. Depending on your circumstances, we can also discuss an individual relocation plan to our hubs in Armenia, Georgia, Serbia, Poland, and Spain.

What you can expect
  • Flexible working hours, coordinated with your team and the needs of your role.
  • Autonomy and responsibility from day one.
  • Opportunities to grow through the quality and impact of your work.
  • AI Allowance to your preferred tools
  • Participation in our employee stock option program.
We’re committed to an inclusive, high-performing workplace where people from different backgrounds have the support to grow and achieve their goals.
If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we’d love to hear from you.

raw.description:
About OpenMined

OpenMined is a 501(c)(3) non-profit foundation that brings together leading minds in AI, security, and privacy technology to develop open-source solutions that transform how data can be accessed and shared. Founded in 2017, we've grown into a global community of over 18,000 members working to ensure that privacy protection and AI innovation reinforce each other rather than undermine one another. We are driven by a simple challenge: the most valuable data for solving humanity's greatest challenges remains locked away due to privacy concerns, and we can change that through technology rather than compromise.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own how OpenMined plans, tracks, and ships its most ambitious work. You'll work most closely with Ronnie Falcon, Chief Product Officer, and you'll be the person accountable for timelines, dependencies, and delivery across our product, engineering, research, and partnerships teams.

OpenMined runs several high-stakes efforts at once. ScreamingFace is an open-source toolkit for composing multiple LLMs into systems that beat any single frontier model, with a public leaderboard and a research fellowship. AI Oversight builds privacy-preserving infrastructure that lets AI labs, auditors, and safety institutes run evaluations without exposing models or data, with pilots alongside frontier labs. These efforts span multiple teams, tools, and funders, and they move fast under real research uncertainty.

Our product leads decide what to build, and our tech leads decide how it's built. You'll own when and in what order it gets delivered. That means turning goals into milestones with real dates, keeping roadmaps current rather than rewriting them once a year, and making our tools a source of truth people trust. It also means telling leadership early when a date is about to slip and what the options are.

This is a technical role. You'll work daily with engineers and researchers on distributed systems, LLM infrastructure, and privacy-enhancing technologies. You don't need to write production code, but you need to understand the work well enough to break it down, spot risk, and challenge an estimate.

We're an AI-native team. Our engineers ship with AI coding agents, our main codebase releases several times a week, and our tools and habits keep evolving as AI does. We're looking for a seasoned technical program manager who has built and run project management practices for teams like this. You'll bring years of hands-on experience, use AI to make planning, tracking, and reporting faster and lighter, and help OpenMined become a team that is excellent at project management, not one that depends on a single person to do it.

This is an independent contractor engagement, roughly a full-time commitment, with an initial 12-month term we expect to renew. You set your own schedule, but we need your working hours to overlap substantially with US Eastern business hours (your local time between one hour behind and two hours ahead of ET).

Responsibilities

  • Own delivery end to end for OpenMined's flagship initiatives (ScreamingFace and AI Oversight), from quarterly goals to milestones, dependencies, and release dates.
  • Design, run, and keep improving our project management practice for an AI-native team: planning, tracking, status reporting, and retros built around how engineers work with AI agents today, and updated as those tools change.
  • Build AI into how we manage projects: use and build AI agents and automations that draft status updates, summarize Linear, GitHub, and meeting activity, flag risks and stale work, and keep plans current with little manual upkeep.
  • Make the whole team better at project management: set standards and templates, coach product and engineering leads, and grow project management skills across the team, laying the groundwork for future project management hires.
  • Turn quarterly OKRs into dated, sequenced plans with product and engineering leads, and keep them current as research results and priorities shift.
  • Run a living product roadmap that is reviewed on a regular cadence and can feed grant proposals and funder reports without a last-minute rewrite.
  • Be the single accountable owner for cross-team dependencies when one initiative spans several boards, teams, or external partners, and chase down blockers yourself before they cause a slip.
  • Own our project management tooling (Linear for engineering, Asana for cross-functional work): set conventions, cut noise, and make sure status in the tools matches reality.
  • Connect code to plans: make sure work in GitHub links to Linear issues across all active repos, and keep PR review, release status, and repo ownership visible.
  • Track and report progress on milestones, cycle time, and OKR key results to leadership, and flag slipping dates early with clear trade-off options.
  • Coordinate external deliverables such as partner pilots, program launches (e.g., our research fellowship), and grant milestones, so commitments to partners and funders are met.

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • 7+ years of technical project or program management, delivering complex software with product and engineering teams. Transferable experience, such as a software engineering background, will also be considered.
  • Built or rebuilt a project management practice: set up planning cadences, tooling, and standards that a team kept using, earned buy-in through credibility rather than heavy process, and raised others' project management skills.
  • Has shaped project management for AI-native teams: worked with engineers who build with AI coding agents, and changed processes as those workflows evolved.
  • Uses AI in their own project management work every day: has built or set up AI agents, automations, or workflows for status reporting, risk detection, planning, or tracker hygiene, and can show concrete results.
  • Delivered under continuous shipping and technical uncertainty: R&D, ML/AI, infrastructure, or developer platforms with frequent releases and changing plans.
  • Technical foundation: a computer science or other technical degree, or 3+ years working as a software engineer. Comfortable reading code, PRs, and architecture docs.
  • Deep, hands-on use of engineering trackers such as Linear, Jira, and GitHub. You've designed a team's workflow, not only used one.
  • Clear, concise communication, written and spoken: you can explain status, risk, and trade-offs to engineers, executives, and funders.

Preferred

  • Experience working on a fully remote, distributed team.
  • Has mentored or managed other project or program managers, or helped hire them.
  • Experience with LLMs, AI evaluation, AI safety, or privacy-enhancing technologies.
  • Experience at an early-stage startup or research lab where you built the delivery process from scratch.
  • Experience managing grant-funded or partner-funded deliverables, such as reporting milestones to funders.
  • Experience coordinating with external partners on pilots or integrations (e.g., AI labs, research institutions, government).
  • Open-source project experience, as a contributor or as a project or release manager.

Compensation

  • Contract fee: $76,000 - $96,000 USD annualized, invoiced monthly.
  • Actual offers will be determined based on the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location.

Benefits

  • Mission-Driven Work: Be part of a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization, focused on social impact rather than profit, offering the chance to make a meaningful difference in the world.
  • Open Source Contribution: Make a real impact by contributing to an Open Source project that benefits a broad community.
  • Collaborative Global Team: Join a dynamic, international team that values collaboration and diversity.
  • Flexible Work Hours: Enjoy the autonomy to structure your work hours around what best fits your life and productivity.
  • Fully Remote Work: Work remotely within the location requirements for this role.

raw.excerpt: Position Summary... What you'll do... AI is reshaping how Walmart builds technology, serves customers and associates, operates the business, and makes decisions.
raw.description:
Position Summary...

What you'll do...

AI is reshaping how Walmart builds technology, serves customers and associates, operates the business, and makes decisions. As AI rapidly evolves across traditional machine learning, generative AI, multimodal models, and agentic systems, we are building an Enterprise AI Platform that provides the common foundation for AI workloads across Walmart.

The platform brings together capabilities spanning MLOps, model and inference access, LLM gateway services, developer experience, model lifecycle management, observability, governance, reliability, and AI economics. Its purpose is to help teams across Walmart build and operate AI solutions quickly, safely, reliably, and economically at enterprise scale.

As Senior Director of Product Management for the Enterprise AI Platform, you will define the product vision, strategy, and execution for one of the foundational platforms powering Walmart’s AI transformation.

This role requires more than traditional product management. You will need to understand where AI technology is heading, determine which capabilities should become durable enterprise platform primitives, and translate rapidly changing technology into a coherent product strategy. You will work closely with senior engineering leaders, architects, AI teams, infrastructure teams, governance and security partners, and business leaders to make decisions spanning models, infrastructure, developer experience, safety, economics, and platform architecture.

The ideal leader combines strong product judgment, meaningful technical depth, deep understanding of the AI ecosystem, strategic thinking, storytelling, executive influence, financial discipline, and a bias for action. You will bring clarity to ambiguity, stay grounded in customer and engineering realities, raise the bar continuously, and operate with the ownership of an entrepreneur and the maturity of an enterprise leader.

What You’ll Do

  • Define the product vision and strategy: Establish the long-term direction for Walmart’s Enterprise AI Platform and translate Walmart’s AI ambitions into clear product priorities, platform capabilities, and investment decisions.
  • Build for the evolution of AI: Anticipate shifts across foundation models, multimodal AI, agents, inference technologies, orchestration, and AI infrastructure, and ensure the platform evolves ahead of enterprise demand.
  • Create durable platform abstractions: Determine where common capabilities should exist across models, providers, infrastructure, lifecycle management, governance, and developer workflows so teams can move faster while preserving flexibility and optionality.
  • Drive model and infrastructure optionality: Enable teams to use the right models and infrastructure based on capability, quality, performance, cost, availability, and risk while minimizing unnecessary provider or technology lock-in.
  • Create a world-class developer experience: Simplify how engineers, data scientists, and product teams discover AI capabilities, onboard, experiment, evaluate, deploy, observe, and operate AI workloads from development through production.
  • Make cost a first-class product consideration: Build platform capabilities and product mechanisms that help teams understand and optimize model consumption, infrastructure utilization, unit economics, capacity, and cost-performance tradeoffs.
  • Embed safety and governance into the platform: Partner with AI Governance, Security, Privacy, Legal, Compliance, and Risk teams to make enterprise controls, observability, and guardrails scalable and easy for engineering teams to adopt.
  • Make the safe path the easiest path: Create platform defaults and paved roads that improve speed, reliability, security, governance, and cost efficiency at the same time.
  • Own the AI ecosystem strategy: Continuously evaluate commercial models, open models, infrastructure providers, emerging AI technologies, and open-source ecosystems. Determine where Walmart should build, buy, partner, integrate, or standardize.
  • Separate durable trends from hype: Develop informed perspectives on emerging AI technologies and identify which changes materially affect Walmart’s platform strategy and which do not.
  • Understand customers deeply: Build strong relationships with engineering, product, data science, and business teams. Use customer feedback, product telemetry, adoption data, and direct engagement to identify friction and shape the roadmap.
  • Drive adoption through product value: Build a platform teams choose because it makes them faster and more effective. Identify barriers to adoption and systematically remove them.
  • Partner deeply with Engineering: Operate as a strategic counterpart to engineering leadership and engage credibly on architecture, APIs, inference, MLOps, orchestration, reliability, observability, capacity, and developer workflows.
  • Turn ambiguity into direction: Frame complex problems, establish principles, evaluate tradeoffs, make decisions with incomplete information, and move teams from ambiguity to execution.
  • Tell a compelling platform story: Translate complex technical concepts into clear narratives for engineers, product teams, senior executives, and business leaders, connecting platform investments to enterprise strategy and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly: Balance foundational investments, customer needs, technology evolution, reliability, technical debt, safety, cost, and strategic bets while keeping the organization focused on the areas of highest enterprise leverage.
  • Measure product outcomes: Establish metrics spanning adoption, onboarding, developer productivity, reliability, performance, utilization, cost efficiency, governance coverage, customer satisfaction, and business impact.
  • Lead across organizational boundaries: Align Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Governance, Security, Data, Finance, Procurement, and business teams around common priorities and decisions.
  • Build a high-performing product organization: Recruit and develop strong product leaders and create a culture of customer focus, technical curiosity, ownership, intellectual honesty, urgency, and high standards.

What You’ll Bring

  • Extensive product leadership experience building and scaling AI/ML platforms, developer platforms, cloud platforms, infrastructure products, or other highly technical enterprise platforms.
  • Demonstrated success defining platform strategy and translating it into roadmaps, technical capabilities, operating mechanisms, adoption, and measurable outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of the modern AI ecosystem, including machine learning, generative AI, foundation models, multimodal systems, AI agents, inference, MLOps, model lifecycle management, evaluation, observability, and AI infrastructure.
  • Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with senior engineers, architects, distinguished technical leaders, infrastructure teams, and AI experts on complex architectural and product decisions.
  • Strong product judgment and the ability to distinguish between individual feature requests and reusable platform capabilities that create enterprise leverage.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand APIs, platform abstractions, developer workflows, distributed systems, reliability, performance, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of AI economics, including model pricing, token consumption, inference costs, infrastructure utilization, capacity, and cost-performance tradeoffs.
  • Proven ability to operate in rapidly evolving and ambiguous environments, establish first principles, create structure from incomplete information, and drive decisions and execution.
  • Strong strategic and systems thinking, with the ability to connect customer needs, technology evolution, architecture, economics, risk, and enterprise strategy.
  • Exceptional storytelling and executive communication skills, with the ability to simplify sophisticated technical concepts while preserving the substance needed for sound decisions.
  • Strong listening skills, maturity, self-awareness, and intellectual flexibility. Able to form clear points of view, challenge assumptions, and change direction when evidence warrants it.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and highly technical teams across organizational boundaries through credibility, clarity, and results.
  • A strong bias for action and practical problem solving, balanced with the judgment to recognize when foundational decisions require deeper consideration.
  • Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to connect platform investments and technology decisions to cost, efficiency, adoption, risk, and business value.
  • Experience building and developing strong product teams and senior product leaders.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset combined with enterprise leadership maturity: the ability to move with urgency, challenge existing assumptions, create new possibilities, and build capabilities that operate reliably at global scale.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading product strategy for AI/ML platforms, MLOps platforms, inference or model gateways, GenAI platforms, developer platforms, or large-scale cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience across commercial and open model ecosystems and understanding of the technical and economic implications of model optionality.
  • Experience with model gateways, routing, quotas, capacity management, inference optimization, evaluation, prompt or model lifecycle management, agents, and runtime observability.
  • Experience building platforms that support both traditional ML and generative or agentic AI workloads.
  • Experience with AI governance, Responsible AI, security, privacy, or safety engineering.
  • Experience owning products with significant infrastructure or third-party consumption costs and driving improvements in unit economics.
  • Experience making build-versus-buy decisions and working with cloud providers, model providers, open-source technologies, and emerging AI companies.
  • Experience leading global product teams and influencing highly distributed engineering and business organizations.

What Success Looks Like

You will establish the Enterprise AI Platform as the preferred foundation for building and operating AI across Walmart.

Teams will move from experimentation to production faster. Developers will be able to adopt new models and AI capabilities without repeatedly rebuilding foundational infrastructure. Walmart will maintain flexibility across models, providers, and infrastructure as the ecosystem evolves.

The platform will make cost, safety, reliability, governance, and developer experience core product capabilities. Teams will have the visibility and tools needed to make intelligent tradeoffs across quality, performance, economics, and risk.

You will build a clear platform strategy that anticipates where AI is going while remaining grounded in the problems customers face today. You will earn the trust of engineering and business leaders through sound judgment, technical credibility, practical action, and consistent execution.

The strongest leader in this role will see around corners, bring clarity to ambiguity, translate rapid AI evolution into durable platform strategy, inspire through a compelling narrative, make difficult decisions with confidence, develop other leaders, and build a world-class AI platform that allows Walmart to move faster, operate safely, and use its scale as a competitive advantage.

At Walmart, we offer competitive pay as well as performance-based bonus awards and other great benefits for a happier mind, body, and wallet. Health benefits include medical, vision and dental coverage. Financial benefits include 401(k), stock purchase and company-paid life insurance. Paid time off benefits include PTO (including sick leave), parental leave, family care leave, bereavement, jury duty, and voting. Other benefits include short-term and long-term disability, company discounts, Military Leave Pay, adoption and surrogacy expense reimbursement, and more.

You will also receive PTO and/or PPTO that can be used for vacation, sick leave, holidays, or other purposes. The amount you receive depends on your job classification and length of employment. It will meet or exceed the requirements of paid sick leave laws, where applicable.

For information about PTO, see .

Programs range from high school completion to bachelor's degrees, including English Language Learning and short-form certificates. Tuition, books, and fees are completely paid for by Walmart.

Eligibility requirements apply to some benefits and may depend on your job classification and length of employment. Benefits are subject to change and may be subject to a specific plan or program terms.

About the company

Paid per approved task, about $35/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $35/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

raw.description:
About Upstart

At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence.

As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress.

We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you.

If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you.

The Team

Upstart’s Secured Lending organization is building the first-line risk and control infrastructure that will support the next stage of growth across home equity line of credit, auto direct, and auto indirect dealer products. The team helps ensure secured lending products operate with clear governance, durable controls, high-quality execution, and readiness for bank partner and regulatory review.

Asset Quality & Model Oversight is responsible for monitoring portfolio-wide trends across loan salability, asset quality, and model performance. This function looks across the portfolio over time — tracking performance against investor and bank partner thresholds, interpreting model execution patterns, identifying systemic risk, and escalating findings before they become repurchase events, partner concerns, or examination issues.

As the Senior Manager, Asset Quality & Model Oversight at Upstart, you will own this function end-to-end, reporting directly to the Head of Secured Lending. You will lead a small team of analysts and partner closely with Credit Risk, Capital Markets, Model Risk Management, Product, Engineering, Compliance, Legal, Operations, and bank partners to establish the methodology, monitoring cadence, governance materials, and reporting routines that keep Upstart’s secured lending portfolio within risk appetite and exam-ready.

How you’ll make an impact

  • Lead the secured lending asset quality and loan salability function across home equity line of credit, auto direct, and auto indirect dealer channels, setting the review methodology, operating cadence, reporting standards, and escalation routines for a small team of asset quality analysts.
  • Monitor portfolio-level salability risk across secured lending channels — tracking eligibility adherence trends, defect patterns, collateral documentation quality, and exception concentrations; escalate repurchase and put-back risk to Capital Markets and bank partners before they affect loan sale execution or partner commitments.
  • Monitor asset quality and portfolio performance indicators tied to salability, including early payment defaults, delinquency, loss severity, prepayment, non-performing loan trends, exception patterns, and threshold breaches.
  • Evaluate origination and channel quality across secured lending programs, including collateral documentation completeness, lien perfection, override trends, pricing consistency, dealer or partner performance, concentration risk, and potential fair lending exposure.
  • Own first-line model implementation and performance oversight for secured lending models, including production model monitoring, threshold tracking, version control, use-case boundaries, model inventory updates, change impact assessment, and escalation of performance degradation or out-of-bounds behavior.
  • Translate loan review findings, portfolio trends, and model performance signals into action by identifying root causes, defining remediation plans, tracking issue closure, and escalating risks before they affect loan sale execution, partner commitments, or regulatory readiness.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in financial services risk management, compliance, credit operations, asset quality, model governance, or a related control function supporting secured or asset-backed consumer lending products.
  • Experience with loan-level quality review, loan salability oversight, investor delivery, repurchase or put-back risk, bank partner audits, collateral documentation review, or pre-sale quality control in a regulated lending environment.
  • Experience monitoring portfolio performance and asset quality indicators across multiple origination channels, including early payment default, delinquency, prepayment, loss severity, non-performing loan trends, credit policy exceptions, threshold breaches, or channel-level pricing and fair lending patterns.
  • Experience with first-line model oversight, production model monitoring, model implementation governance, model inventory documentation, or model performance escalation processes.
  • Experience leading analysts, managing a review function, or owning cross-functional risk, compliance, credit, asset quality, or operations programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with auto indirect or dealer channel lending dynamics, including pricing discretion, dealer markup, and fair lending considerations relevant to indirect origination channels; ability to partner with fair lending oversight functions to interpret and escalate channel-level findings.
  • Knowledge of secured lending and secondary-market quality expectations, including exposure to first mortgage or asset-backed lending frameworks such as investor eligibility standards, collateral documentation, lien perfection, representations and warranties, defect remediation, trailing performance thresholds, and repurchase or make-whole risk.
  • Knowledge of consumer lending and fair lending requirements relevant to secured products, including Equal Credit Opportunity Act/Regulation B, Unfair, Deceptive, or Abusive Acts or Practices, Fair Credit Reporting Act, TILA/Regulation Z, dealer markup oversight, adverse action, or credit decisioning controls.
  • Ability to evaluate production model execution, validation outputs, fair lending review outputs, underwriting accuracy, pricing consistency, and performance trends against approved thresholds.
  • Skilled in producing exam-ready policy documents, governance materials, issue tracking, executive summaries, and bank partner reporting.
  • Risk or compliance certification, such as Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager, Financial Risk Manager, or equivalent credential.

Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote

Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time.

At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process.

In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k).

United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range
$172,100—$238,300 USD

What you'll love

At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly
  • Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only)
